title: Design Engineer
description:
**Electrical Engineer – Primary Systems** 




*Substation Primary Design \& Delivery \| Utilities Domain* 




  
 



 As Electrical Engineer – Primary Systems, you will be responsible for the design, technical assurance and delivery support of primary plant across the Utilities Domain — including power transformers, switchgear, busbars, cabling and earthing systems within zone substations and distribution infrastructure. You will work within a multidisciplinary project environment alongside secondary systems, civil/structural, planning and delivery teams to ensure primary designs are safe, compliant, constructible and cost\-effective.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Prepare and review primary system designs for new and augmented zone substations, switching stations and distribution feeders, including single line diagrams, equipment layouts and general arrangement drawings.
* Undertake primary plant sizing, rating and selection (transformers, switchgear, busbars, cables) in accordance with Client standards and Australian Standards.
* Perform earthing, fault level, voltage drop and equipment clearance studies to support primary design outputs.
* Coordinate primary design interfaces with secondary systems, civil/structural and mains design disciplines to ensure a fully integrated substation solution.
* Support outage planning, testing, commissioning, energisation and handover activities for primary plant.
* Identify and manage technical risks relating to equipment integration, earthing and network performance.
* Provide technical input into procurement, cost estimating and tender evaluation for primary equipment packages.
* Conduct design verification, site inspections and non\-conformance resolution to maintain quality and compliance.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of primary design standards and lessons\-learned processes.



**About You** 




  
 



 You are a motivated electrical engineer with a strong grounding in high\-voltage primary plant and a genuine interest in solving complex, real\-world network design challenges.
 



**Essential Qualifications** 




 Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical) or equivalent.
 



 Willingness to travel to project sites.
 



 Strong Communication skills\-English
 



**Skills \& Experience** 




 4 to 10 years of experience in primary/substation electrical design within the energy, utilities or infrastructure sectors. Strong working knowledge of HV/LV switchgear, power transformers, busbar systems and earthing design. Familiarity with Australian Standards and NSW distribution network design practices ( Utilities Client or comparable DNSP). Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or 3D design tools (Revit, Navisworks) for substation layout and general arrangement work.
 



**Electrical Engineer – Secondary Systems** 




*Protection, Control, SCADA \& Automation \| Utilities Client , NSW* 




  
 



 Utilites Client Secondary Systems asset base — protection, control, SCADA, communications and automation equipment across the network — carries a replacement value of approximately $200 million and is central to safe, reliable network operation, including digitised substations such as South Erskine Park zone substation.
 



 As Electrical Engineer – Secondary Systems, you will design, review and support the delivery of protection, control and automation systems, working closely with primary design, network planning and asset management teams to ensure secondary systems meet performance, safety and regulatory requirements across new works, augmentations and asset renewal.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Design and develop secondary systems for substations, including protection schemes, control and SCADA architecture, and detailed electrical schematics. Prepare protection relay settings, coordination studies and testing/commissioning documentation for new and modified network assets. Support the strategic asset management of secondary systems, including condition assessment, renewal planning and lifecycle optimisation of the installed asset base. Coordinate secondary design interfaces with primary and civil/structural disciplines to ensure a fully integrated, constructible substation solution. Contribute to digital substation and IEC 61850\-based automation initiatives, supporting the transition to modern, fibre\-based control architectures. Coordinate outage planning, testing, commissioning, energisation and handover activities for protection and control systems. Identify and manage technical risks relating to protection systems, earthing, equipment integration and network performance. Provide technical input into procurement, cost estimating and tender evaluation for secondary systems packages. Support continuous improvement, lessons\-learned and engineering best\-practice initiatives across secondary systems delivery.
 



  
 



**About You** 




 You are an experienced electrical engineer with a passion for protection, control and automation systems, and enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines to deliver safe and reliable network outcomes.
 



**Essential Qualifications** 




 Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical) or equivalent.
 



 Willingness to travel to project sites.
 



 Strong Communication skills\-English
 



  
 



**Skills \& Experience** 




 4 to 10 years of experience in secondary systems / protection and control engineering within the energy or utilities sector. Strong understanding of protection relays, SCADA, RTUs and communications systems, ideally including IEC 61850 digital substation architecture. Experience with strategic asset management principles as applied to secondary systems (condition monitoring, renewal planning, risk\-based prioritisation). Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work confidently across teams, contractors and vendors.
 



**Note: Until VISA process, you have to work from Madhapur location and once VISA processed need to work at Sydney Ausralia**

title: Associate - Balance Sheet & Control COE
description:
**Job Description**

 The Accounting Control Associate is responsible for supporting the organization's financial governance and control framework by ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records. The role focuses on balance sheet reconciliations, ASC 606 revenue recognition controls, journal entry oversight, audit support, SOX compliance, and month\-end close activities. The successful candidate will help maintain a strong control environment while ensuring compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 1\. Balance Sheet Reconciliations
   

  




* Prepare, review, and maintain timely and accurate balance sheet reconciliations.


* Investigate and resolve reconciling items, aging balances, and unusual fluctuations.


* Ensure compliance with reconciliation policies and control requirements.


* Monitor account integrity and support remediation of identified issues.



 2\. Revenue Recognition Controls (ASC 606\)
   

  




* Perform validations and control procedures related to ASC 606 revenue recognition requirements.


* Review supporting documentation to ensure revenue transactions are recognized accurately and in accordance with company policies and accounting standards.


* Identify and escalate revenue\-related risks, anomalies, and control gaps.


* Partner with Finance, Revenue Assurance, and Controllership teams to ensure compliance.



 3\. Journal Entry \& Month\-End Close Governance
   

  




* Review journal entries for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to accounting policies.


* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close processes.


* Drive consistency and quality in financial reporting and account reconciliation activities.


* Ensure timely completion of close activities and reporting requirements.



 4\. SOX Compliance, IPE \& Audit Readiness
   

  




* Execute and document SOX controls and Information Produced by the Entity (IPE) validation procedures.


* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and supporting evidence for internal and external audits.


* Assist with control testing, audit requests, and remediation efforts.


* Support continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen the overall control environment.



 5\. Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
   

  




* Develop and maintain control metrics, dashboards, and status reports.


* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.


* Support implementation of best practices in financial controls, governance, and compliance.


* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to drive process standardization and control effectiveness.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.


* Professional certification such as CA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent is preferred.


* 2\-5 years of experience in accounting, financial controls, reconciliations, audit, compliance, or controllership functions.


* Strong understanding of US GAAP, ASC 606 revenue recognition principles, and SOX compliance requirements.


* Experience supporting month\-end close and financial reporting processes.


* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.


* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet critical deadlines



 Preferred Skills \& Experience
   

  




* Experience working in a SOX\-regulated, multinational, or publicly traded company environment.


* Hands\-on experience with:


* OneStream (Account Reconciliations)


* SAP (GL, Journal Entries, Financial Reporting)


* Microsoft Excel (Advanced functions, Pivot Tables, Power Query)


* Power BI or equivalent reporting tools


* Prior experience supporting internal or external audits.


* Knowledge of process improvement, automation, and control optimization initiatives.



  

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

title: Software Engineering Lead - Data Services
description:
Firmable is the market\-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia Pacific — and we're scaling that success globally at pace. Backed by leading investors and 2,000\+ customers, we exist to give sales teams an unfair advantage: the deepest company and people data of any platform, enriched with real\-time signals, served at the right moment by intelligent agents.
 



 The backend services, APIs, and AI systems behind every Firmable product are the engine room. This role owns it.
 



**The Role** 




 As Software Engineering Lead, you'll own the function that designs, builds, and operates the backend services, RESTful APIs, and AI/LLM systems powering every Firmable product. You'll lead two engineering pods through their team leads while staying deeply hands\-on yourself. Reporting to the Head of Data \& Services.
 



 This is not a people\-management seat. \~80% hands\-on architecture and engineering, \~20% leading the function. You whiteboard the system, write the reference implementation, then raise the whole team to that bar. If you want to step away from the code, this isn't it.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Backend and API architecture — Firmable's Python services (FastAPI, Pydantic, Logfire): the secure, well\-documented backbone every product, internal agent, and external customer depends on
* Data modelling — schemas, access patterns, and integrity at scale across PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and DynamoDB
* AI/LLM services and agents — production systems that are fast, idempotent, observable, and cost\-bounded; every LLM call a named, versioned tool with prompts, schemas, traces, and evals
* Harness engineering — the agent runtime the team builds on: tool\-calling and MCP server layers, structured\-output validation, bounded agentic loops, sandboxed execution, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, replayable traces
* Eval harnesses — scorers, labelled sets, trajectory and multi\-turn evals, LLM\-as\-judge calibration, regression suites in CI, drift detection on vendor model updates
* Scale and reliability — systems serving millions of API calls: idempotency, caching, rate limits, cost ceilings, circuit breakers, bounded retries, graceful degradation
* Observability standard — structured traces, p50/p95/p99 by stage, cost per request, and the dashboards that make it legible
* Function leadership — lead and grow two pods through their leads; run architecture and code reviews; set the bar for quality, testing, and AI\-native practice
* Cross\-functional glue — connect Data Platform, Application, and Product; turn early ideas into architecture decisions and working prototypes fast



**What We're Looking For** 




 Must Haves
 


* 7\-10 years hands\-on backend engineering, including time leading engineers or engineering leads with 3\+ years of hands on experience with Python.
* Built and operated large\-scale production systems — millions of API calls, and you know what breaks first when load grows
* Expert Python with deep production experience in FastAPI
* Shipped AI/LLM services, APIs, and agents in production — and stood up the evals that keep them trustworthy
* Harness engineering experience — you've built the scaffolding agents run inside: tool\-calling frameworks, MCP servers, eval and test harnesses other engineers depend on, and you can walk us through it in detail
* Hands\-on data modelling across SQL and NoSQL
* Designed and consumed RESTful services at scale
* Shipped real work with agentic IDEs — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent. Not "tried it" — your default mode
* Lead from the front — whiteboard to reference implementation to a team operating at that standard



 Highly Valued
 


* Eval frameworks (Braintrust, Inspect AI, Promptfoo) and tracing stacks (Logfire, OpenTelemetry)
* Agent frameworks and protocols — Claude Agent SDK, Pydantic AI, LangGraph, MCP
* AWS and/or GCP at scale — ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB
* B2B data, entity resolution, or high\-throughput enrichment pipelines
* Snowflake and modern data\-platform tooling
* Startup or scaleup experience where you shipped fast and owned outcomes end to end



**How We Build** 




 Firmable is an AI\-native organisation. Agentic development, AI\-driven test generation, automated review pipelines, and built\-in evals and traces are the default mode of working, not a productivity experiment. Recurring workflows ship as versioned SKILL.md specs any teammate or agent can run.
 



 We run lean and ship fast — small senior teams, no layers, minimal process, weekly releases moving toward daily. Teams own their stack end to end. You need to be working this way already, and able to bring a team with you.
 



**Why This Role** 



* Own the engine room — you're not joining a team, you're leading the function
* Architectural latitude — the next generation of our services and AI platform is yours to shape
* Hands\-on leadership — the influence of a lead with the satisfaction of still building
* Massive leverage — your work reaches every Firmable customer, every day
* Competitive base \+ meaningful equity — a share in the upside we're building toward



 Firmable is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products.

 Cloud Services Team is searching for a Reliability Engineer. Candidate must have hands\-on experience operating and engineering services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including data, compute, and observability services. The team is accountable for the operations, engineering, and governance of 200\+ Cloud Technologies across a multiple cloud environment. Role requires helping mature operational practices for GCP workloads as part of our multi\-cloud strategy. * Implement alerting strategies aligned to error budgets and production reliability goals; reduce alert noise and prevent toil.
* Execute incident response, triage, and post‑incident analysis for GCP services, contributing to PIRs and corrective actions.

* Drive automation\-first operations, including self‑healing patterns using Cloud Functions, Cloud Run jobs, Scheduler, and event‑driven remediation.

* Understanding of Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Dataproc, and Cloud Composer for data/ML workflows.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines targeting GCP using Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, and Terraform.

**Nice to Have**

* Intermediate Microsoft office skills

**What We Offer**

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early\-career professional with foundational knowledge in scripting and a keen interest in Generative AI. The role involves learning and applying automation principles by developing, testing, and maintaining scripts across Windows and Linux environments, significantly utilizing AI tools as a coding companion to accelerate development and quality.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with Senior DevOps Engineers and technical mentors who will guide your professional growth, review your code, and assist with complex troubleshooting. As part of the DevOps and IT Operations team, you’ll collaborate with colleagues to automate maintenance, deployments, and monitoring across Windows and Linux lab environments. You will also leverage Generative AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot as daily companions to accelerate script development and solve technical challenges.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* AI\-Guided Scripting: Work closely with senior engineers, leveraging Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, internal coding assistants) to write, debug, and understand foundational Shell (Bash/Zsh) and PowerShell scripts.
* Automation Development: Assist in developing simple to moderate automation scripts for system maintenance, basic deployment tasks, data extraction, and monitoring checks on both Linux and Windows Lab systems.
* Learning \& Adaptation: Quickly learn and apply standard scripting best practices, including proper error handling, logging, and security considerations, often by analyzing and refining AI\-generated code snippets.
* Testing and Validation: Rigorously test and validate newly developed and modified scripts to ensure they function correctly and securely across target environments.
* Documentation Support: Help create clear, simple documentation and runbooks for automation processes and the scripts you develop.
* Version Control: Utilize Git for script version control, collaborating with the wider team on code check\-ins and reviews.
* Basic Troubleshooting: Participate in the troubleshooting of automation failures and assist senior staff in identifying root causes related to script logic or environment configurations.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Foundational Scripting Knowledge: Academic or practical exposure to at least one primary scripting language: PowerShell or Shell (Bash/Zsh).
* Aptitude for AI Tools: Demonstrated interest, through academic projects or personal use, in leveraging Generative AI/LLMs (like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot) for coding assistance.
* Basic OS Knowledge: General understanding of command\-line interfaces and file system navigation in both Windows and Linux/Unix operating systems.
* Problem Solving: A strong desire to learn, an analytical mind, and a proactive approach to solving technical challenges.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to clearly document work and ask effective questions.


**Additional Information**
 Arista stands out as an engineering\-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
   

  

 We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
   

  

 Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R\&D centers equal in stature.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

 About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

 Position Overview:
   

  

 The Counter Executive / Senior Counter Executive serves as the first point of contact for walk\-in customers at Blue Dart retail counters, delivering a professional, efficient and customer\-centric service experience. The role is responsible for assisting customers with shipment bookings, service enquiries, documentation, payment processing and shipment tracking while ensuring a seamless and positive customer experience.
   

  

 Reporting to the Branch Operations Head or Service In\-charge, the incumbent represents the Blue Dart brand through courteous customer interactions, operational accuracy and service excellence. The role contributes directly to customer satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), retail revenue growth and customer retention by consistently delivering high\-quality service and promoting appropriate logistics solutions.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 To provide an exceptional customer experience at Blue Dart retail counters by accurately processing customer shipments, addressing enquiries, promoting relevant services and ensuring efficient counter operations while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, operational accuracy and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 Customer Service \& Retail Counter Operations
   

  

 Welcome walk\-in customers professionally and provide prompt, courteous and personalised service.
   

  

 Understand customer requirements and recommend the most appropriate Blue Dart products and services.
   

  

 Accept, process and book domestic and international shipments in accordance with established operational procedures.
   

  

 Assist customers with shipment documentation, packaging guidance and service\-related enquiries.
   

  

 Ensure accurate data entry and transaction processing within operational systems.
   

  

 Shipment Booking \& Transaction Management
   

  

 Verify shipment details, documentation and packaging prior to acceptance.
   

  

 Generate shipment documentation, labels, invoices and customer receipts accurately.
   

  

 Process cash, digital and other approved payment methods in accordance with company policies.
   

  

 Maintain complete accuracy in shipment booking, documentation and billing activities.
   

  

 Ensure timely closure of all counter transactions and daily operational records.
   

  

 Customer Experience \& Relationship Management
   

  

 Deliver a consistently positive customer experience aligned with Blue Dart's service standards.
   

  

 Resolve customer queries, concerns and complaints professionally or escalate them appropriately.
   

  

 Provide shipment status updates and assist customers with tracking and delivery\-related enquiries.
   

  

 Promote customer confidence through clear communication and proactive service.
   

  

 Build strong customer relationships that contribute to repeat business, customer loyalty and improved Net Promoter Score (NPS).
   

  

 Retail Sales \& Brand Representation
   

  

 Promote Blue Dart's products, value\-added services and packaging solutions based on customer needs.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to maximise retail revenue through effective customer engagement.
   

  

 Maintain a professional appearance and ensure the retail counter reflects Blue Dart's brand standards at all times.
   

  

 Support local customer engagement initiatives and promotional campaigns where applicable.
   

  

 Represent the organisation with integrity, professionalism and a customer\-first mindset during every customer interaction.
   

  

 Cash Management \& Financial Controls
   

  

 Receive and process customer payments through cash, cards, digital payment modes and other approved channels.
   

  

 Ensure accurate billing, receipt generation and reconciliation of all customer transactions.
   

  

 Maintain complete accountability for cash collections, petty cash (where applicable) and daily financial transactions.
   

  

 Perform daily cash balancing, counter closing and submission of collections in accordance with company procedures.
   

  

 Report discrepancies, shortages or irregularities immediately to the reporting manager.
   

  

 Maintain confidentiality and security of financial transactions and customer payment information.
   

  

 Counter Administration \& Operational Compliance

title: Customer Care Executive
description:
The Customer Care Executive will be responsible for delivering a high\-quality, consistent, and customer\-centric experience to Skechers India customers across multiple touchpoints. The role will serve as a key interface between the customer and the organization, ensuring timely resolution of queries, complaints, feedback, product\-related concerns, order\-related issues, and service requests.
   

  

 The incumbent will work closely with Retail, E\-commerce, Logistics, Warehouse, Finance, Marketing, Product, IT and other relevant teams to resolve customer issues effectively and within defined turnaround times.
   

  

 The role requires strong communication skills, empathy, problem\-solving ability, attention to detail, and a strong understanding of customer service standards in a premium retail environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Customer Query \& Complaint Management
* Handle customer queries and complaints received through multiple channels, including:
+ Phone calls
+ Emails
+ Website / Contact Us
+ Social media/customer messaging channels, where applicable
+ E\-commerce platforms
+ Retail store escalations
+ Other customer communication platforms

* Understand customer concerns and provide accurate, relevant and timely resolutions.
* Handle queries related to:
+ Product availability
+ Product specifications and features
+ Size and fit
+ Orders and deliveries
+ Returns and exchanges
+ Refunds
+ Warranty\-related concerns
+ Product defects/damages
+ Store\-related experiences
+ Promotions and offers
+ Gift cards/vouchers, where applicable
+ Online purchase issues

* Maintain a professional, courteous and empathetic approach while dealing with customers.
* Complaint Resolution \& Escalation Management
* Take ownership of customer complaints from initiation through closure.
* Investigate complaints by coordinating with relevant internal teams and external partners.
* Ensure complaints are resolved within defined Turnaround Time (TAT) and service\-level standards.
* Escalate complex, sensitive or high\-priority cases to the appropriate team/manager.
* Track escalated cases until closure and ensure customers receive timely updates.
* Identify recurring issues and highlight them to the reporting manager for corrective action.
* Handle dissatisfied or irate customers professionally while protecting the brand experience.
* Order \& E\-commerce Support
* Assist customers with online order\-related queries, including:
+ Order confirmation
+ Order status
+ Shipment tracking
+ Delivery delays
+ Cancellation requests
+ Returns and exchanges
+ Refund status
+ Incorrect/missing products
+ Damaged products

* Coordinate with the E\-commerce, Warehouse, Logistics and relevant third\-party partners for issue resolution.
* Ensure customers are kept informed throughout the resolution process.
* Follow established policies and processes while ensuring a customer\-friendly approach.
* Retail Store Customer Support
* Coordinate with Skechers retail stores on customer complaints and service\-related issues.
* Support store teams in resolving customer concerns that require corporate intervention.
* Ensure appropriate communication between customers, stores and corporate functions.
* Track store\-related complaints and identify recurring service gaps.
* Share customer feedback with the Retail and Operations teams to support service improvement.
* CRM \& Case Management
* Accurately record all customer interactions, complaints, requests and resolutions in the CRM/customer service system.
* Maintain complete and accurate customer records in accordance with company processes and data privacy requirements.
* Update case status, actions taken, escalation details and closure remarks.
* Ensure no customer complaint remains unattended or without appropriate follow\-up.
* Maintain proper documentation of customer interactions for future reference and reporting.
* Customer Experience \& Brand Representation
* Act as a strong ambassador of the Skechers brand during every customer interaction.
* Deliver a consistent customer experience aligned with Skechers' brand values and service standards.
* Demonstrate empathy, patience and ownership when handling customer concerns.
* Understand customer needs and provide solutions rather than simply responding to queries.
* Ensure communication is professional, clear and aligned with approved company policies.
* Cross\-functional Coordination


**Work Closely With Relevant Stakeholders, Including**
* Retail Operations
* E\-commerce
* Warehouse \& Supply Chain
* Logistics / Courier Partners
* Finance
* IT
* Marketing
* Product / Merchandising
* Legal, where required
* Store Operations
* Regional / Area Teams


 Ensure effective coordination and timely closure of customer\-related issues.
   

  

* Customer Feedback \& Insights
* Capture customer feedback, suggestions and service concerns.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and communicate trends to the reporting manager.
* Support the preparation of customer feedback reports and dashboards.
* Highlight frequent complaints related to:
+ Products
+ Stores
+ Website
+ Delivery
+ Returns/refunds
+ Customer service
+ Promotions

* Provide actionable insights to relevant teams for improving customer experience.
* Service Quality \& Performance Monitoring
* Adhere to defined customer service KPIs and SLAs.
* Monitor personal performance against parameters such as:
+ Response Time
+ Resolution Time
+ First Contact Resolution
+ Complaint Closure
+ Customer Satisfaction
+ Quality of Interaction
+ Case Backlog
+ Escalation Rate

* Maintain high standards of accuracy and service quality.
* Participate in regular quality audits, coaching sessions and process improvement initiatives.
* Process \& Policy Adherence
* Follow all approved customer service policies, SOPs and escalation matrices.
* Ensure customers receive information that is accurate and consistent with company policies.
* Avoid unauthorized commitments, discounts, refunds, replacements or exceptions.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer information and adhere to applicable data privacy and information\-security requirements.
* Ensure all customer interactions are handled in accordance with company guidelines.
* Reporting \& MIS
* Prepare and maintain daily/weekly/monthly customer service reports as required.
* Track:
+ Total customer contacts
+ Complaints received
+ Complaints resolved
+ Pending cases
+ TAT adherence
+ Escalations
+ Customer feedback
+ Major complaint categories
+ Repeat complaints

* Support the reporting manager with customer service dashboards and management presentations.
* Maintain accurate records for business reviews and audits.
* Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and reduce repetitive customer complaints.
* Recommend improvements in FAQs, communication templates, SOPs and customer journeys.
* Support automation and digital initiatives aimed at improving customer experience.
* Participate in customer experience improvement projects and new process rollouts.


**About Skechers**
 Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Senior Performance Advertising Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a results\-oriented Senior Performance Advertising Engineer to own and drive the optimization of our buyer\-side and performance marketing systems. In this role, you will be directly responsible for designing algorithms, building data systems, and refining optimization loops that drive Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for our Advertisers and Agencies.You will own the technical architecture and end\-to\-end evaluation, implementation, and scaling of robust data pipelines for attribution data. This position spans our complete omnichannel environment, requiring expert\-level performance engine development across Mobile App (including privacy\-aware frameworks like SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox), Video, Connected TV (CTV),and Desktop environments.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* ROAS Optimization \& Algorithmic Design: Develop, benchmark, and deploy real\-time bidding (RTB) algorithms, pacing controls, and predictive models aimed squarely at maximizing ROAS and conversion tracking across all screens (CTV, Mobile App, Video, and Desktop).
* Attribution Data Pipelines: Design, evaluate, and implement scalable, low\-latency streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest, validate, and process complex conversion and multi\-touch attribution (MTA) datasets.
* Omnichannel Execution: Advance PubMatic’s performance capabilities across specific programmatic formats.
* Mobile: Build robust mechanisms that thrive within SKAdNetwork, Attribution API, and Android Privacy Sandbox constraints.
* CTV \& Video: Implement precise cross\-device graph integrations, household\-level frequency capping, and server\-to\-server attribution systems.
* Desktop: Innovate alternative identity framework integrations (e.g., UID2, LiveRamp ATS) to sustain high attribution fidelity post\-third\-party cookies.
* Data Pipeline Evaluation: Constantly audit existing data ingestion points for architectural flaws, data loss, or systemic latencies that negatively skew attribution accuracy and campaign performance.
* Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high\-performance, low\-latency, and memory\-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+) matching our ultra\-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience focusing on performance advertising, programmatic bidding, or large\-scale user\-conversion optimization loops.
* Attribution Domain Expertise: Demonstrated track record of evaluating and implementing multi\-touch attribution (MTA), last\-touch attribution (LTA), or incrementality testing frameworks in a production environment.
* Data Engineering \& Scale: Hands\-on experience engineering pipelines handling terabyte\-to\- petabyte scale data via distributed frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Kafka, and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Format Versatility: Strong technical familiarity with technical specs supporting Mobile App (IDFA/GAID loss mitigations), CTV (App Transport Security, IFA standards), and Desktop environments.
* Deep understanding of the OpenRTB protocol, DSP/SSP mechanics, and supply\-path optimization (SPO).
* Experience deploying production\-grade Machine Learning frameworks for CTR/CVR prediction.
* Strong system\-level performance benchmarking skills (profiling memory allocation, reducing I/O bottlenecks.


**Qualification**
 Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university.

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Linux \& HW Engineer at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 ADSIPL offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining AWS computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost\-effective manner.
   

  

 At ADSIPL, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress. If your career path is in Systems, Network or Database Engineering, Software Development or maybe AWS Support, Technical Operations or perhaps Project Management, we will create a development plan to enable you to succeed reaching those goals. This begins on Day One!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 A Data Centre Linux \& HW Engineer at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:
   

  

* You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
* your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break\-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
* You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
* You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
* You perform on\-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
* You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
* You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
* More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
* This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation


 A day in the life
   

  

* You will support DC (Data Center) infrastructure equipment (e.g. racks, servers, networking devices, hardware components, cables, etc.),
* You will follow the instructions ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.
* You will perform on\-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
* You will be involved with site management and maintain tidiness in operation areas
* Your role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

description:
**Position Summary**
 The Product Analyst supports the Product Team and their client business processes and operations by maintaining and enhancing existing products and creating new ones. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical expertise to work with large datasets, derive insights, and deliver value to stakeholders as well as product management and development experience. The Product Analyst combines operational, technical, and analytic skills with problem\-solving and communication abilities. You will collaborate with and work closely with Senior Data Analyst and/or Product Owner(s) to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**
* Operational Execution:
+ Understand and communicate client business needs and issues, operating rules, data structures, and standard operating procedures.
+ Execute and suggest improvements to pre\-defined operational procedures.
+ Implement process improvement in operational workflows, working with Senior Data Analysts and Product Owners.
+ Assist Product Owners to streamline the ideas to development processes, and the technical requirements processes.

* Product Development:
+ Enhance and maintain data products by understanding the data, product(s)/offering(s), client needs, and business goals.
+ Collaborate with stakeholders regarding business objectives.
+ Support product management with product development, and execution.
+ Partner with Product management to create, maintain and update roadmap documentation
+ Assist teams towards common objectives and document the solutions/decisions made.
+ Create technical requirements, user stories and test plans as part of an Agile methodological approach.

* Data Analysis:
+ Compare datasets / various inputs to ensure data quality and derive actionable insights.
+ Apply quality checks and validations to the product delivery, reporting results and elaborative summary for internal team and important stakeholders.

* Stakeholder collaboration:
+ Coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones to ensure smooth working within timelines.
+ Assist engineering teams with knowledge transfer and testing of new operational procedures and enhancements.
+ Facilitate knowledge transfer and overall product knowledge for engineering, Engagement and other teams.
+ Partner with stakeholders e.g. Engagement and Product Owners to understand client business needs and pain points with the intention to write user stories that address those needs.
+ Work closely with product team: Owners, developers and testers to ensure that written requirements are clearly stated, and comprehensive.

* Knowledge development:
+ Build subject matter expertise in operational processes, data tools, content, and necessary technology, and Scrum / Agile methodologies
+ Remain updated on tools, techniques, and working models to enhance processes.
+ Develop functional understanding of the product offering via the technology and deployment stack, to facilitate writing effective user stories, requirements and user acceptance criteria.

* Project Management:
+ Work on multiple client tasks simultaneously, strengthening analytical, task management, and communication skills.
+ Keep track of unplanned internal and clients’ tasks arising from any developments to existing or new products.
+ Maximize time management skills to balance workload in order to complete multiple deadline driven projects with a minimum of supervisory input.

* Coordinate meetings and prepare status update documentation / meetings for ongoing projects Research and Problem\-Solving
+ Conduct secondary research e.g. marketplace conditions, competitive environment, best practices to keep the product quality best\-in class while being able to address clients’ questions related to the same.
+ Coordinate and co lead design sessions to document feature requirements and guide stakeholders towards decision\-making.
+ Investigate issues and recommend solutions to improve processes.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Required \-**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics/Communication, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
* 1 – 2 years of experience using data mining languages/tools like SQL (for analysts), Excel. Exposure to stored procedures is a plus.
* Detail orientation with a strong focus on quality, analytics, and operations.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals, Managed Markets Consulting or Analytics Consulting with broad based experience in, managed care, and/or analytics will be an advantage.
* Proven ability to work with global teams across different time\-zones.


**Preferred**
* Masters in these disciplines OR MBA/PGDM/Equivalent
* Experience in product development, management, or operations.
* Strong knowledge of US Healthcare, payer/provider datasets, and managed care analytics.
* Familiarity with tools like Retool, Power BI and Power Query.


**Competencies**
* Operational Outlook:
+ Translate macro tasks into actionable steps and document, execute, and track them efficiently.
+ Seek opportunities for automation and process improvements while transferring knowledge to team members.

* Analytical Skills:
+ Thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
+ Strong problem\-solving and critical\-thinking capabilities.

* Communication Skills: Written, Verbal, and Presentation.
+ Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to simplify complex processes for diverse audiences and respond promptly to inquiries.

* Collaboration and Teamwork:
+ Work effectively across teams and cultures, sharing constructive feedback to achieve team goals.
+ Demonstrate sound judgement, task management, and conflict resolution skills.

title: Fire Officer
description:
**Fire Officer** 




  





 As a Fire Officer, you will be responsible for implementing and monitoring fire safety systems, procedures, and emergency preparedness across all the high rise buildings. You will oversee fire prevention measures, safety inspections, firefighting readiness, drills, compliance, and emergency response while coordinating with internal teams and external agencies.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





**About the Role** 




  




* Oversee day\-to\-day fire safety operations and ensure compliance with established procedures.
* Conduct regular inspections to identify fire hazards and unsafe conditions.
* Ensure fire protection systems and equipment remain operational and readily accessible.
* Monitor fire extinguishers, hydrants, hose reels, fire alarms, sprinkler systems, fire pumps, and related equipment.
* Conduct and coordinate regular fire drills, mock drills, and emergency response exercises.
* Ensure emergency exits, escape routes, fire doors, and access areas remain clear and accessible.
* Lead and coordinate emergency response during fire and other critical incidents.
* Supervise Firemen and other fire safety personnel and ensure proper deployment.
* Coordinate with facility, security, maintenance, and project teams on fire safety requirements.
* Coordinate with fire system AMC contractors and service providers for inspection, testing, and maintenance.
* Maintain fire safety records, inspection checklists, drill reports, incident reports, and statutory documentation.
* Assist in obtaining and maintaining applicable fire safety approvals, certificates, and compliance requirements.
* Investigate fire incidents and near\-misses and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct fire safety training and awareness sessions for employees and other personnel.
* Ensure compliance with HN Safal’s fire safety policies, SOPs, and applicable regulations.
* Report safety risks, system deficiencies, and major observations to senior management.



  





**About You** 




  




* Diploma/Degree in Fire \& Safety, Fire Engineering, or a related field.
* 5–10 years of experience in fire safety, preferably in real estate, commercial buildings, construction, or large facilities.
* Strong knowledge of firefighting systems, fire prevention, emergency response, and evacuation procedures.
* Hands\-on knowledge of hydrants, sprinklers, fire pumps, fire alarms, extinguishers, and other fire protection systems.
* Experience in conducting fire drills, inspections, risk assessments, and incident investigations.
* Knowledge of applicable fire safety regulations and statutory requirements.
* Experience in supervising fire safety teams and coordinating with contractors/vendors.
* Strong communication, leadership, and emergency\-response skills.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and prepare safety reports.
* Physically fit, alert, disciplined, and capable of handling emergency situations effectively.



  





**Why Join HN Safal?** 




  




* Opportunity to work with a reputed real estate organization.
* Exposure to professional fire safety systems and large\-scale operations.
* Opportunity to take ownership of fire safety and emergency preparedness.
* Work closely with facility, operations, and senior management teams.
* Opportunity for long\-term growth with HN Safal.

title: NETSUITE ARCHITECT
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – NETSUITE ARCHITECT (FIXED TERM CONTRACT \- 2 Years)**
**THE TEAM \& THE JOB**
 The Enterprise Systems NetSuite team owns the support, development and strategic direction of YouGov's NetSuite ERP platform, the system underpinning the company's core finance processes. The team is being reshaped to combine operational analyst support with dedicated architectural capability under the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager.
   

  

 As NetSuite Architect, you will be the expert\-level professional providing technical leadership for the platform on a fixed term contract. You will own the overall technical vision and architecture, define the "how" and "what" of solutions on significant and unique issues, and act as the recognised subject matter expert advising senior stakeholders. You will translate the functional vision for the ERP into an architectural plan and guide its execution, maintaining a future\-focused approach to scalability, maintainability and long\-term platform evolution.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing – Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end technical vision and architecture for the NetSuite platform, translating business strategy into an architectural roadmap.
* Design and architect end\-to\-end NetSuite solutions, including customisations, integrations and workflows, exercising considerable creativity, foresight and judgment.
* Make high\-impact technical decisions on integration patterns, customisation approaches and data models, evaluating trade\-offs between business needs, intangibles and technical constraints.
* Assess and document the existing customised NetSuite landscape (scripts, workflows, forms, integrations) to support future transitions and upgrades.
* Architect integrations across multiple systems using SuiteTalk, RESTlets and middleware platforms.
* Define and enforce NetSuite development standards, governance policies and best practices across the platform.
* Lead complex, enterprise\-wide NetSuite initiatives from requirements gathering through deployment and post\-go\-live support.
* Conduct solution design reviews, code reviews and performance optimisation assessments, providing expert technical leadership and mentorship to the wider team.
* Advise senior business and functional stakeholders, developing recommendations and persuading diverse audiences on platform decisions and module/third\-party evaluation.
* Produce comprehensive technical architecture documentation, data models and integration specifications so knowledge is retained beyond the contract term.
* Work closely with the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager, the Senior NetSuite Analyst, Finance stakeholders and third\-party providers, staying current with NetSuite platform updates and industry trends.


**What You Need To Know (technical \& Behavioural Skills/Competencies)**
* 6–8\+ years' hands\-on NetSuite experience operating as an architect, with a proven track record of leading full implementation lifecycles as a technical leader.
* Experience architecting solutions independently across multiple implementations or complex enterprise\-wide projects, in more than one enterprise\-sized organisation.
* Deep technical expertise across the entire NetSuite platform, including expert knowledge of SuiteScript 2\.x (Client, User Event, Scheduled, RESTlets, Map/Reduce) and custom development.
* Extensive experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST), SuiteAnalytics and SuiteBundler, and a deep understanding of NetSuite data architecture, saved searches and custom records.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and experience with integration platforms (Boomi, Celigo, Workato, MuleSoft or similar).
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and ERP business processes (Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Financial Close).
* Conceptual thinking to work on significant and unique issues where analysis requires evaluation of intangibles, with independent judgment on methods, techniques and evaluation criteria (be accountable).
* Ability to convey complex, non\-routine information and persuade diverse senior stakeholders across multiple cultures, frequently advising others on complex matters (communicate clearly).
* A collaborative approach to technical leadership, building capability in others rather than holding knowledge (trust each other), and staying current with platform and industry developments (be fast).
* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteFoundation; SuiteCloud Developer II preferred) and ideally architect qualifications such as TOGAF or CSA.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.


**Why join YouGov?**
 Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.
   

  

 Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.
   

  

**Life at YouGov**
 We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.
   

  

 We strive to provide YouGovers with best\-in\-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity or expression, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, HIV status, political affiliation, socioeconomic background, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law or in line with our responsibilities as a fair and ethic employer. All employment decisions are made based on occupational qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Technical Lead- Platform Engineering
description:
**Technical Lead – Platform Engineering**
***Where Growth Never Stops***
*At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.*
*When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.*
*If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it —*
*Fuller is where that happens.*
**About The Department**
 The Online Reliability Services Software Development team builds customer\-facing digital products that improve equipment reliability and performance for cement producers worldwide. As Fuller Technologies expands its in\-house software development capabilities, this growing team offers a unique opportunity to influence technology, engineering culture, and future product innovation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Technical Lead, Platform Engineering, you will be the technical authority for our global Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS). You will shape the architecture and technical direction across Edge connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data platforms, APIs, analytics, and customer\-facing applications.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the development of secure, scalable, and highly available digital solutions that enable predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, and data\-driven services for customers worldwide. Working closely with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software engineers, Edge developers, and domain experts, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions while driving engineering excellence, cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and platform innovation.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Serve as the technical lead for the global IIoT platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS), providing architectural guidance and technical direction across software development teams.
* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end platform architecture spanning Edge devices and connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and customer\-facing applications.
* Design scalable, resilient, secure, and high\-performing cloud\-native solutions using Azure services, including Azure IoT Hub, cloud messaging, data storage, event\-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
* Guide technical design and development across Java, Node.js, C\#, REST APIs, microservices, and real\-time data processing technologies, ensuring seamless integration between industrial equipment, Edge devices, cloud services, and enterprise applications.
* Establish engineering standards, development practices, and architecture principles that promote maintainability, scalability, software quality, and security.
* Mentor and develop software engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing, while fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Drive platform operational excellence and maintain availability of 99\.9% or greater through effective monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead disaster recovery, business continuity, backup validation, failover strategies, resilience testing, and root\-cause analysis for critical production issues.
* Optimize Microsoft Azure infrastructure and resource utilization to balance platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud operating costs.
* Champion secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices and industrial cybersecurity principles, including IEC 62443, while partnering with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams to identify and mitigate technical risks.
* Partner with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software and Edge developers, data engineers, automation engineers, and domain experts to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Support technical estimation, solution reviews, project and release planning, and clearly communicate technical strategies, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, cloud services, and engineering practices, and contribute to the long\-term technology roadmap for IIoT, digital services, and industrial automation.
* Drive continuous improvements that enhance platform scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, engineering productivity, and overall customer value.


**You bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree or relevant technical certifications are preferred.
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, cloud platform engineering, industrial digital solutions, or related technology domains.
* 3\+ years of demonstrated technical leadership experience, providing architectural direction and guiding engineering teams in the delivery of enterprise software or cloud platform solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting production cloud platforms using Microsoft Azure.
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Edge computing, industrial automation, manufacturing technologies, or connected equipment solutions is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of engineering and technology principles, with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working within Agile development environments and structured Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
* Strong systems thinking, critical thinking, and complex problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and operational issues and drive effective solutions.
* Ability to evaluate technology alternatives, understand system dependencies, and make sound architectural and technical decisions.
* Proven ability to provide technical leadership, influence engineering teams, coordinate resources, and work effectively across multiple functions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working effectively in global, cross\-functional, and multicultural environments.
* A collaborative, accountable, and continuous\-improvement mindset with a strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and customer value.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.


*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*

title: Human Centered Change Manager
description:

title: Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Why it’s worth it:
   

  

 ReliaQuest’s Quality Engineering team is evolving quality from a test\-execution function into a platform capability focused on automation, reliability, and production safety. As an Associate Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help build automated testing and continuous integration capabilities across backend services, web applications, and mobile platforms.
   

  

 This is a code\-first, automation\-focused engineering role—not a manual testing or documentation\-only position. You will gain hands\-on experience with production\-level systems, test automation, CI/CD, failure analysis, and AI\-assisted engineering practices. Training, pairing, and guidance will be provided, with attitude and aptitude valued over previous job titles.
   

  

 The everyday hustle:
   

  

* Build and maintain automated API smoke and regression tests for backend services.
* Contribute to UI automation using Playwright and, based on interest and business needs, mobile automation.
* Improve test reliability, test data setup, and environment stability.
* Develop and maintain automated tests that run within GitLab CI pipelines.
* Investigate flaky or failing pipelines and, with guidance, determine whether failures are caused by product defects, test code, or environmental issues.
* Analyze logs, metrics, and test reports to identify and troubleshoot failures across services and environments.
* Create clear, actionable bug reports that include reproduction steps and relevant technical details.
* Collaborate with Software Engineering, SRE, and DevOps teams to resolve quality and reliability issues.
* Contribute to test standards, automation frameworks, pre\-commit hooks, engineering helpers, and other quality tooling.
* Help shape how quality is consistently measured and enforced across services.
* Use Claude and other AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test discovery, automation design, code review, failure triage, and technical documentation.
* Identify repeatable Quality Engineering tasks where AI can improve speed, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Carefully validate and refine AI\-generated outputs to ensure they meet engineering, reliability, and security expectations.
* Share useful AI prompts, patterns, and workflows with the broader QA/SDET team.
* Continuously improve automation and quality practices to help prevent incidents rather than only identify defects after they occur.


 Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* Foundational experience reading and modifying code in Java, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and HTTP status codes.
* Familiarity with Git and branch\-based development workflows.
* A willingness to debug issues across multiple layers, including test code, services, pipelines, and environments.
* An automation\-first mindset and an interest in building reliable, maintainable test solutions.
* Working knowledge of Claude or similar AI\-assisted engineering tools and an understanding of how they can support test design, automation, debugging, failure analysis, and productivity.
* The judgment to validate, refine, and correct AI\-generated recommendations rather than accepting them without review.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when documenting defects and collaborating with technical teams.
* A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn through training, pairing, and feedback.


 What makes you uncommon?
   

  

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or automated quality gates.
* Experience with test automation frameworks or API testing tools.
* Familiarity with Playwright, Selenium, or mobile automation technologies.
* Experience reviewing logs, dashboards, metrics, or monitoring tools.
* Exposure to production or staging incidents and root\-cause investigation.
* Experience using AI tools to generate or improve automation scripts, test cases, API scenarios, or debugging workflows.
* Familiarity with prompt\-writing techniques for technical work such as log analysis, code explanation, test coverage review, and root\-cause analysis.
* An interest in improving shared automation platforms, developer tooling, and organization\-wide Quality Engineering practices.

description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management to join our team within our Clinicals division. In this role you will be responsible for one or more product areas within the overarching product’s portfolio; understanding the market and customers, contributing to the product vision, developing business cases and ensuring a set of product features meet business requirements. You will help define how AI is responsibly integrated into clinical workflows, ensuring solutions are safe, trustworthy, and deliver measurable value to healthcare providers and patients.
   

  

 You will work closely with scrum teams defining and writing user stories, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade\-off decisions between scope and schedule. Your work will span both strengthening our current solutions and delivering innovative, AI\-driven features that improve user experience and clinical decision\-making. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in provider efficiency, mobile adoption, workflow completion, user satisfaction, product quality, and safe adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Mobile team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve the efficiency and experience of healthcare providers. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions where they add value. The team collaborates closely to ensure products are usable, reliable, and aligned with clinical and business needs. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Drive product vision incorporating AI/ML capabilities, predictive insights, and automation opportunities
* Lead early\-stage discovery for features including: Identifying high\-value use cases for AI, Validating concepts with users and stakeholders, and Defining data requirements and feasibility
* Partner with UX, Analytics and Data Science teams to define measurement strategies for AI feature performance (e.g., validity, bias, data quality, adoption, impact)
* Translate product strategy into outcome\-based roadmaps that connect customer problems, business goals, delivery priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Define product success metrics for each major initiative, including adoption, engagement, workflow efficiency, customer satisfaction, safety, and business impact.
* Own go\-to\-market strategies for products, including its AI\-enabled features
* Monitor post\-release performance and use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to guide iteration and prioritization.
* Work directly with scrum teams to prioritize work and ensure delivery of both core and AI\-enabled product capabilities
* Own ongoing maintenance of core products, including triaging production issues and managing enhancements
* Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate AI models into scalable product features
* Understand the market opportunity via user needs, market forces, applicable business models, emerging AI trends and competitive AI capabilities
* Drive the analysis of Product Area(s) of ownership including AI/ML\-driven products
* Define epics and user stories that clearly articulate: Functional requirements, User experience considerations, Data and model requirements, AI behavior expectations (e.g., explainability, confidence levels)
* Partner with UX and Engineering to design mobile experiences that are intuitive, accessible, performant, and reliable in fast\-moving clinical environments.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to manage the full AI/ML lifecycle, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree required: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or related field preferred
* 6\+ years of product management experience
* Understanding of US healthcare / health IT environment is strongly preferred
* Experience working in an Agile environment is strongly preferred
* Experience building or scaling mobile products, preferably iOS and Android applications in SaaS, healthcare, or enterprise environments.
* Understanding of mobile UX patterns, performance considerations, accessibility, release management, and app adoption strategies.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and productization of AI features
* Familiarity with: Model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring), Data pipelines and data quality considerations, Experimentation frameworks
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model bias, and explainability
* Experience working on AI\-driven or data\-intensive products preferred
* Experience bringing products to market is needed
* Technical understanding (mobile, SaaS, data, APIs) – ability to check technical feasibility and timelines and remove technical development barriers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business value


**Additional Information**
* Some travel to the US may be required for customer site visits, internal collaborations, and industry events (5%)
