 Email \& Inquiry Support
   

  

* Respond to and manage all inbound registration and enrollment support emails within defined SLAs
* Triage inquiries and route to the appropriate team (Billing, Centre Directors, Sales \& Admissions) as needed
* Maintain a professional, consistent tone and brand voice across all email communication


 Registration \& Documentation Support
   

  

* Support processing of registration documentation and required paperwork received by email
* Ensure registration records are complete, accurate, and compliant
* Confirm program placement and start\-date details are correctly reflected in internal records


 Compliance \& Government Reporting
   

  

* Complete accurate and timely monthly entries in the Alberta Government Child Care Portal (CCPN)
* Ensure all entries are aligned with internal records and submitted within required timelines


 Billing Coordination
   

  

* Act as the coordination point for billing\-related inquiries received by email
* Log, track, and route billing issues to the appropriate team
* Follow up to ensure timely resolution and communication back to families
* This role does not process payments or make financial decisions.


 CRM \& Data Integrity
   

  

* Maintain high standards of CRM data accuracy and completeness for existing leads and enrollments
* Ensure consistent tracking of interactions and updates
* Support improvements to workflows and reporting processes


 Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Maintain regular reporting on email volumes, response times, and resolution rates
* Identify recurring issues, gaps, and operational challenges
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve support processes and outcomes


 Cross\-Training \& Business Continuity
   

  

* Maintain clear, up\-to\-date documentation of key support processes and workflows
* Cross\-train with the Sales \& Admissions team to build knowledge of related processes and dependencies
* Support onboarding and training of new team members as required
* Ensure continuity of operations during absences, transitions, or peak periods through effective knowledge sharing


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Post\-secondary education in Business Administration, Operations, Communications, or a related field
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered


**Experience**
* 2\+ years of experience in customer support, administrative, or back\-office operations, ideally email/ticket\-queue based
* Experience using CRM systems and managing data\-driven processes
* Experience supporting North American clients/customers is an asset
* Experience in childcare, education, or service\-based environments is an asset


 Key Skills
   

  

* Excellent written English communication with strong attention to detail
* High accuracy and consistency when working with data and documentation
* Ability to manage a high volume of email inquiries while maintaining response\-time targets
* Comfort working in a structured, process\-driven environment
* Problem\-solving mindset with the ability to escalate issues appropriately
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams without direct authority


**Work Environment Requirements**
* Based in Chennai, India
* Split\-shift schedule covering approx. 60% Mountain Standard Time (MST) and 40% India Standard Time (IST) business hours, to provide coverage during both Canada and India working hours
* Reliable internet and a quiet workspace suitable for sustained email/documentation work
* Ability to manage periods of high volume and time\-sensitive work, with flexibility during peak enrollment periods


**Additional Requirements**
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately
* Commitment to delivering a high\-quality experience for families and internal stakeholders
* Adaptability to evolving processes, systems, and organizational structures
* Willingness to take on additional responsibilities as required to support business needs
* Alignment with the organization's values, standards, and commitment to excellence in early childhood education

 Area
   

 Expected Knowledge

 RDP, remote desktop/support tools
   

 Asset Management
   

 Hardware/software inventory
   

 Troubleshooting
   

 Hardware, OS, application and connectivity

title: Associate Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
The Associate \- Accounts Receivable is responsible for the Order\-to\-Cash activities of its Business Lines covering billing, collections, cash application, and revenue recognition and reporting — ensuring accuracy, timely recovery of receivables, and clear visibility of customer outstanding balances for the business.
   

  

 The role brings standardisation to customer\-level visibility of revenue, invoicing and outstanding balances, and holds ownership of collections performance for an assigned customer portfolio, including ageing, DSO and overdue exposure. It requires a sound understanding of the business and its revenue drivers, the ability to manage large data sets and present up\-to\-date insights, control over pricing in the revenue systems, and effective partnering with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices, billing queries and customer escalations.
   

  

**Requirements**
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

* Maintain up\-to\-date, detailed pricing data to support invoicing and revenue management
* Apply control checks on invoicing data across all revenue streams
* Participate in the end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable process, from invoice generation through to collection and cash application
* Prepare, review and issue customer invoices accurately and on schedule, ensuring supporting data, tariffs and contractual terms are correctly applied before dispatch, and resolving discrepancies prior to release
* Manage collections for an assigned customer portfolio: monitor ageing reports, follow up on overdue invoices through structured dunning, and escalate long\-outstanding or high\-risk accounts in line with the agreed escalation matrix
* Issue statements of account and payment reminders, and record committed payment dates and collection notes to maintain a reliable receivables and cash\-inflow forecast
* Perform cash application on a daily basis, allocating incoming receipts to the correct customer invoices and matching remittance advices accurately
* Interact with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices — sharing overdue positions, obtaining customer feedback, resolving billing queries and disputes, and jointly agreeing recovery actions on ageing accounts
* Coordinate and assist in year\-end finalisation and audits, providing AR schedules and supporting documentation


**Requirements**
 Minimum Education/Qualification: Bachelor of Commerce (CMA, CA, B. Com or BBA); accounting certifications an advantage.
   

  

 Min. Experience :
   

  

* 4\+ years' experience in accounts receivable, billing or order\-to\-cash
* Direct communication with customers on billing and collections matters


 Industry
   

  

* 
* Order\-to\-cash, billing, collections or revenue accounting environment
* 
* Maritime technology, shipping services or a transaction\-based business preferred


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Hands\-on experience across the end\-to\-end order\-to\-cash cycle: billing, collections and cash application
* ERP experience (NetSuite or equivalent), including the AR and billing modules
* Maintenance of pricing and tariff data in revenue systems, including approval controls
* Control over credit notes and amendments to issued invoices
* Cash application, remittance matching and clearing of unapplied, unidentified or short\-paid receipts
* Statements of account, structured dunning and escalation processes
* Revenue reconciliation between invoicing and operational data
* Monthly revenue reporting, budget deviation analysis and forecasting models
* Analytics and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) for AR, billing and revenue reporting

 We’re looking for dedicated team player with the skills and vision to build a better tomorrow. Join our Tax team as a Tax Manager and ensure compliance with TP regulations. Also help us build the technology that will transform entire industries, cities and even countries.
   

  

 The position exists as a support function to the Tax department to fulfil statutory obligations applicable to the company.
   

  

**Change the future with us!**
* Assistance in preparation and filing of Return of Income, tax audit and transfer pricing (Form 3CEB) requirements as per statutory deadlines.
* Undertaking all TP compliances (including BEPS related Master file, CBC, etc.) and filing of tax and TP returns of foreign affiliates.
* Preparing TP documentation to support intra\-group transactions in compliance with local regulations.
* Supporting audits, respond to the assessment notices, prepare appeals and submissions, attending hearings before the tax authorities.
* Advice on TP implications of new business initiatives. Advise on TP queries received from business, interpret various tax treaties, MLI, etc.
* Conducting regular review of TP policies in accordance with the latest tax regulations and developments. To ensure that all actions for preparation and filing of TP returns, assessment notices, etc. are handled in time so that exposure of TP adjustment and litigations can be minimized if not eliminated completely.
* Oversight on the company's transfer pricing matters and partnering with multiple stakeholders to provide support on transfer pricing related issues, including industry standards mandated by SEBI LODR.
* You will be involved in Tax Assessments: Review notices, prepare submissions and attend/ organize representation at assessment hearings, provide information as required during the course of assessment proceedings. This may involve coordination with various corporate functions, business steams, external consultants etc.
* Appeals: Draft appeals, attend/organize representation at proceedings conducted by DRP / Commissioner of Income\-tax and Income Tax Appellate Tribunal as required. Briefing the counsel / lawyer, attending hearings before the ITAT, taking adjournments, etc.
* You will be responsible for post assessment activities like getting OGEs, stay of demand, follow up for obtaining refunds, obtaining rectification orders, etc. so that company gets the orders/ refunds as fast as possible.
* Knowledge Management: Keeping abreast of change of laws/ any tribunal/high court decisions so that relevant information is passed on within the team and to the business divisions, so that timely and accurate decisions are taken, and compliance of tax is ensured.
* Assist in various Automation / Digitalization projects.


**You Will Be Working With**
**External \-** 
 Tax authorities, Senior counsels and advocates, External Auditors, Consultants
   

  

**Internal:** 
 Commercials / BA, Technical team, Marketing/ Sales group commercials, Works, CF, Accounts, Personnel, HR, Internal Audit and other Divisions Group companies both domestic and international.
   

  

**We don’t need superheroes, just super minds**
* You are a Qualified CA and you bring 5 to 7 years of experience in transfer pricing area with knowledge of Income Tax Act, DTAA, FEMA and recent case laws etc. Knowledge of Accounting and Finance and Indian GAAP, USGAAP/IFRS, Commercial concepts, Business understanding.
* Conversant with MS office is must. Knowledge of search database, ERP tool such as SAP, ESPIRIT will be an added advantage.
* You should have strong analytical skills and a high attention to detail.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with different partners.


**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens!**
 This role is based in Mumbai (Worli). You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries \- and the craft of things to come.
   

  

 We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
   

  

**Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers**

title: Adaptive Planning Consultant - Workday Success Plans
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Workday Success Plans Delivery Team at Workday plays a crucial role in ensuring customers maximise the value they get from their Workday products. We focus on our customers’ post go\-live journey, assuring long\-term success. We deliver a variety of programs and services ranging from feature assessments to full feature deployments to support their growing and changing business needs within Workday. At Workday, we help the world’s largest organisations adapt to what’s next by bringing finance, HR, and planning into a single enterprise cloud. We work hard, and we’re serious about what we do. But we like to have fun, too! We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and prioritise giving back to our communities, demonstrating a commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our dedication to customer success, coupled with a vibrant and inclusive company culture, sets a strong foundation for continued growth and success at Workday.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? Are you a great communicator who can clearly articulate and demonstrate the value of Workday solutions to our customers?
   

  

 The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro\-consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. Responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how\-to questions, troubleshoot and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.
   

  

 Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday Financials \& Adaptive Planning. In this position we are looking for expertise in the following:
   

  

 Workforce Planning Expertise
   

  

* Strong understanding of Workday Security and Business Processes
* Experience with HR Concepts such as Supervisory Organizations, Position Changes, Headcount Forecasting
* Experience in headcount modeling and analysis


 Workday Financial Planning Expertise
   

  

* Implementation experience with Workday Adaptive Planning
* Proficiency in creating and managing financial models within the platform.
* Ability to develop complex reports and dashboards using Adaptive Planning


 Data Management and Integration
   

  

* Experience with data integration between Workday Adaptive Planning and Workday HCM and/or other HCM systems.
* Proficiency in managing data imports, exports, and data validation.


 If you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, bring your energy and teamwork to the Workday Success Plans team!
   

  

 Primary responsibilities of this role include delivering various services to Workday Success Plans customers. To be successful, this requires:
   

  

 Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
   

  

 Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips \& tricks.
   

  

 Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
   

  

 Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
   

  

 Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
   

  

 Providing one\-on\-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
   

  

 Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
   

  

 Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
   

  

 Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
   

  

 Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption
   

  

 In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other services such as:
   

  

 Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
   

  

 Provide one\-on\-one customer configuration designs
   

  

 Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
   

  

**About You**
 2\+ years of experience with Workday Adaptive Planning implementations
   

  

 5 years of IT implementation experience
   

  

 3\+ years of software consulting experience
   

  

**Additional Qualifications:**
 1\+ years experience in Adaptive Integrations with external systems
   

  

 Workday Adaptive Planning Certification is a huge plus
   

  

 Ability to troubleshoot Adaptive Integrations to external systems
   

  

 Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
   

  

 Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
   

  

 Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously
   

  

 Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required. Advanced degree preferred.
   

  

 Travel may be up to 10%
   

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.

Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
   

  

 If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

title: Quality Inspector –Equipment’s
description:
**Title**
 Quality Inspector –Equipment’s
   

  

**Job Title**
 Quality Inspector –Equipment’s
   

  

**Division**
 KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) provides holistic and value\-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world\-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high\-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.
   

  

**Summary Section**
 The Quality Inspector – Equipment role is a senior quality assurance position responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications throughout the manufacturing and inspection lifecycle of static process equipment, including pressure vessels, heat exchangers, rotating equipment, and associated systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical guidance on quality, welding, and NDE requirements for process equipment.
* Review vendor technical proposals to ensure compliance with project and quality requirements.
* Lead supplier qualification assessments, audits, and evaluations.
* Conduct pre\-inspection meetings with suppliers and stakeholders.
* Review and approve quality documents, including ITPs, welding procedures, weld records, PWHT procedures, NDE procedures, and testing documentation.
* Perform and oversee shop inspections in accordance with approved Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs).
* Coordinate Third\-Party Inspection (TPI) activities and review inspection reports prior to release.
* Develop Critical\-to\-Quality (CTQ) checklists based on project specifications and lessons learned.
* Interface effectively with suppliers, clients, engineering, procurement, and project teams on quality\-related matters.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through the development of quality processes, tools, and best practices.


**Qualifications Including Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.
* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years in a reputable organization.
* Strong experience in pressure vessel fabrication and inspection in accordance with ASME, EN, and other international codes and standards.
* Proven experience with ASME Code\-stamped equipment and fabrication quality control.
* In\-depth knowledge of welding, NDE, heat treatment, pressure testing, final inspection, and quality documentation.
* Experience in inspection and quality control of raw materials, fabrication processes, final product acceptance, and manufacturing records.
* Familiarity with materials such as low\-alloy steels, stainless steels, and nickel\-based alloys including Inconel.
* Experience in witnessing and validating Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, turbines, and associated auxiliary systems.
* Experience in witnessing and validating Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for control valves, instrumentation systems, and related automation equipment to ensure compliance with project specifications and applicable standards.
* Sound understanding of ISO 9001 Quality Management System requirements.
* Proficiency in Refractory and Painting Inspection Requirements will be preferred.
* Exposure to KBR technology static equipment’s is preferred.


**Mandatory**
**Preferred Qualifications Education, Experience, \& Skills:**
* ASNT Level II certifications in:
+ PT (Liquid Penetrant Testing)
+ MT (Magnetic Particle Testing)
+ RT (Radiographic Testing)
+ UT (Ultrasonic Testing)


**Preferred**
* CSWIP or equivalent welding certification.
* Experience in refractory and painting/coating inspections.
* Exposure to KBR technology static equipment.


**Decarbonization – Energy Transition – Sustainability**

 Naukripay Group (Naukri Pay), founded in 2021 and headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, is a human resources and talent\-solutions company focused on connecting job seekers with employers across industries. The organization delivers customized HR services, including manpower support, project\-based hiring, pre\-screening, interviewing, training, and onboarding. title: Corporate Treasury Dealer
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Corporate Treasury Dealer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. The role involves executing and monitoring treasury transactions across money market, foreign exchange market and fixed income instruments in line with the bank’s policies and risk limits. The Corporate Treasury Dealer will analyze market trends, liquidity conditions, and interest rate movements to optimize treasury solutions for clients and deliver hedging strategies for them. Responsibilities include increasing FX wallet in SME segment, understanding client working capital cycle and giving end to end treasury solutions, coordinating with internal stakeholders for business development, and ensuring timely settlement and documentation of trades. The role requires understanding of regulatory process and procedures and adhering to regulatory and internal compliance standards, and supporting the enhancement of treasury processes, systems, and controls.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Treasury Management and Finance skills, with a solid understanding of treasury products, forex market , and risk management and understanding of trade transactions.
* Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret market data, assess risk\-reward trade\-offs, and support decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess expertise in forex market and Trading activities, with familiarity in dealing, pricing, and executing financial instruments.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of regulations and compliance related to treasury operations, including RBI guidelines and internal risk frameworks.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree in Finance, Economics, Business, from top tier colleges ,professional certifications (e.g., CFA,FRM, or treasury\-related credentials) are advantageous.
* Strong numerical aptitude, attention to detail, and proficiency with MS Excel, treasury systems, and market information platforms.
* Effective communication skills, ability to work under time\-sensitive conditions, and a collaborative approach to working with cross\-functional teams.

title: Sr BSO Coordinator
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 




  


**General Summary:**









 The purpose of this role is to plan and prepare the daily presentation schedule for assigned networks in conjunction, and coordinating, with the Programming, On Air Promotion, Sales, Media Planning and Transmission departments, ensuring accuracy, completeness, compliance, and delivery according to the prescribed deadlines.  The schedulers form part of a team working directly under the Broadcast Schedule Operations Supervisor.
 




  


**Key Responsibilities:**







* Creation and finalization of the daily transmission schedule, ensuring accuracy and efficiency whilst remaining reactive to the business.
* Create compliant and optimized traffic schedules in WBD Sales System for assigned channels and manage the accurate export to scheduling system
* The planning and scheduling of Live events and Sports broadcasts across the assigned channel portfolio and territories, liaising with key stakeholders across internal and external platforms to deliver the highest levels of live playout.
* Liaising with the Media Planner to ensure smooth hand over of prepped schedules ready for promo placement.
* Identify issues and work with relevant departments to find solutions ensuring all elements air successfully and fulfill regional regulatory requirements.
* To fully understand break patterns and templates and ensure they are checked and loaded into the system and that all final commercial loads or amendments are actioned.
* Organization and regular revision of presentation templates.
* Liaise with the Media Asset Management team and Regional Sales teams checking all media items are present or accounted for prior to download of schedules to transmission.
* Perform necessary checks to the presentation schedule.
* Liaise with Transmission teams, confirming correct playlist versions have been received and necessary changes to ‘on\-air’ have taken place.


* Perform daily presentation schedule reconciliation in both Scheduling and Sales systems and provide any reports, including discrepancy reports as required by the Supervisor/Manager.


* Attending meetings and building strong relationships with key contacts in the WBD internal and regional offices.
* Cross training to develop knowledge across feeds and regions within the department.
* Any other presentation scheduling tasks required and assigned by the Supervisor that are appropriate and in line with the position.







  


**Requirements:**







* Coordinators will ideally have two or more years’ experience in a presentation/promotion scheduling, traffic or a related role.  However, candidates with an exceptional attitude may also be considered with less experience, to take on in an entry level position.
* Computer literate with prior experience working with Broadcast management and/or Sales systems such as IBMS, BTS, Media Genix.
* Communication skills are a must.
* Great attention to detail and able to work to deadlines efficiently even in pressurized situations.
* Ability to work with others and to follow instructions.
* Operational experience and/or Language skills are an advantage.







  


**Metrics:**



* Delivery of the daily transmission schedules within deadlines and high levels of accuracy.
* To be able to independently resolve basic scheduling issues and commercial load errors.
* To have a broad understanding of the regional aspects of the feed and Channel priorities
* Successfully working with others in the organization as part of the team to ensure all schedules are delivered in a timely manner.
* Working with other departments to ensure all matters relating to the creation of the daily presentation schedule and associated work processes are followed and any issues fed back as required.
* To become proficient in the presentation scheduling functions across numerous channels where required.



















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
 









 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
 
 accessibility page
 
 for instructions to submit your request.

title: Facilities Executive
description:
Facility Executive\- IFM operations
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The Executive is responsible for coordinating and managing integrated facility services operations encompassing both soft services (housekeeping,technical security, reception, catering) and technical services coordination (basic maintenance, vendor liaison, work order management). This role maintains robust governance frameworks to ensure service quality, compliance, and performance excellence across all facility operations. The position requires strong coordination skills, technical awareness, attention to detail, governance capabilities, and a customer service orientation to maintain high service standards, operational efficiency, and occupant satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Soft Services Coordination**
 Coordinate daily operations of housekeeping, janitorial, and cleaning services across the facility. Oversee reception, front\-of\-house services, and visitor management operations. Manage mail room operations including courier services, package handling, and distribution. Coordinate catering services, pantry management, and kitchen/breakroom upkeep. Monitor landscaping, pest control, and waste management services. Ensure proper functioning of employee amenities including meeting rooms, breakout areas, and common spaces. Conduct regular walkthroughs and inspections to ensure service quality and cleanliness standards are met.
   

  

**Technical Services Coordination**
 Coordinate routine maintenance activities for building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and lighting. Manage work order systems for technical service requests and maintenance issues. Liaise with technical vendors and contractors for repairs, preventive maintenance, and servicing. Monitor completion of scheduled preventive maintenance tasks and inspections. Track maintenance schedules for critical building equipment and systems. Coordinate access for technical contractors and ensure proper site induction procedures. Log and track technical issues, service calls, and resolution timelines. Escalate urgent technical matters to Facility Manager or engineering team. Support energy management initiatives by reporting anomalies in consumption or system performance. Assist with coordination of minor building projects and equipment installations.
   

  

**Governance Framework \& Standards**
 Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all soft and technical services activities. Create and implement service delivery standards, quality benchmarks, and performance criteria. Establish inspection protocols, checklists, and quality assurance processes for both service categories. Document workflows, service schedules, and operational guidelines. Maintain governance documentation including policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure alignment with organizational standards and industry best practices. Review and update governance documents regularly to reflect operational changes and improvements. Create technical service protocols including emergency response procedures and escalation matrices.
   

  

**Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**
 Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for all facility services operations. Implement service level monitoring systems and maintain performance dashboards. Conduct regular audits and inspections using standardized assessment criteria. Generate daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management review. Analyze service delivery trends, identify patterns, and highlight areas requiring attention. Maintain performance scorecards for vendors and internal service teams. Track technical service metrics including response times, first\-time fix rates, and equipment uptime. Monitor compliance with preventive maintenance schedules and service intervals. Present findings and recommendations to facility management and stakeholders. Generate equipment performance reports and maintenance history logs.
   

  

**Vendor \& Contractor Management**
 Serve as primary point of contact for soft services and technical services vendors and contractors. Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs and contractual obligations. Coordinate service requests and communicate requirements to service providers. Track vendor attendance, timesheets, and service delivery documentation. Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and feedback sessions. Report vendor performance issues and coordinate corrective actions. Assist with vendor onboarding and orientation to facility requirements. Maintain vendor compliance records including insurance certificates, licenses, certifications, and trade qualifications. Manage vendor escalations and dispute resolution processes. Coordinate technical certifications and equipment\-specific training requirements for contractors.
   

  

**Service Quality \& Compliance Management**
 Implement and monitor service level standards for all facility services. Conduct quality inspections and maintain inspection checklists and reports. Address service deficiencies promptly and follow up on corrective actions. Respond to occupant requests, complaints, and feedback regarding facility services. Maintain high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and service delivery. Verify technical work completion and quality before sign\-off. Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on feedback and observations. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, procedures, and governance requirements. Monitor compliance with service contracts and specifications. Verify compliance with technical standards, building codes, and manufacturer specifications.
   

  

**Documentation \& Records Management**
 Maintain comprehensive facility services records, logs, and documentation systems. Process work orders and service requests through facility management systems (CMMS/CAFM). Document service incidents, non\-conformances, and corrective actions taken. Track consumables inventory including cleaning supplies, pantry items, and amenities. Maintain equipment registers, asset lists, and technical specifications. Document maintenance history, service records, and warranty information. Maintain audit trails for inspections, quality checks, and service delivery. Coordinate supplies ordering and ensure adequate stock levels. Prepare regular reports on service delivery, incidents, and performance metrics. Maintain vendor contracts, insurance certificates, and compliance documentation. Archive historical records and ensure data integrity and accessibility. Maintain technical drawings, equipment manuals, and as\-built documentation.
   

  

**Budget \& Financial Governance**
 Support budget tracking and invoice processing for facility services. Monitor expenditure against approved budgets and highlight variances. Review vendor invoices for accuracy and compliance with contracted rates. Track cost trends and identify opportunities for efficiency improvements. Maintain financial records and support audit processes. Assist in budget preparation and forecasting for facility services. Monitor technical service costs including emergency call\-outs and breakdown repairs. Ensure proper financial controls and approval processes are followed. Identify cost\-saving opportunities through preventive maintenance and service optimization.
   

  

**Health, Safety \& Regulatory Compliance**
 Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations for all facility services activities. Monitor proper use of cleaning chemicals, equipment, and safety procedures. Oversee contractor safety compliance including permits to work and risk assessments. Conduct safety briefings with service providers and maintain safety records. Report safety incidents, near misses, and hazards promptly. Maintain incident logs and investigation documentation. Support emergency preparedness including evacuation procedures and crisis response. Ensure proper waste segregation, recycling programs, and environmental compliance. Monitor regulatory requirements for technical systems including fire safety, lifts, and pressure systems. Conduct risk assessments for facility services operations. Verify contractor licensing and certification compliance for technical trades. Maintain records of statutory inspections and compliance certifications.
   

  

**Work Order \& Request Management**
 Manage facility management system (CMMS) for tracking all service requests and work orders. Prioritize incoming requests based on urgency and impact. Assign work orders to appropriate vendors or internal teams. Monitor work order status and follow up on pending items. Communicate progress updates to requestors and stakeholders. Close completed work orders with proper documentation and verification. Generate work order reports and analyze trends in service requests. Identify recurring issues requiring permanent solutions. Maintain response time metrics and service level compliance. Coordinate planned versus reactive maintenance activities.
   

  

**Occupant Services \& Experience**
 Act as first point of contact for occupant inquiries related to facility services. Coordinate special requests for events, meetings, and workplace activities. Manage meeting room bookings, setup requirements, and catering arrangements. Support workplace hospitality and visitor experience initiatives. Conduct occupant satisfaction surveys and implement feedback. Build positive relationships with building occupants and department representatives. Develop service improvement plans based on user feedback and emerging needs. Communicate planned maintenance activities and potential service disruptions proactively.
   

  

**Project Support \& Continuous Improvement**
 Assist with facility services transitions, vendor changes, and service improvements. Support office moves, workspace reconfigurations, and setup activities. Coordinate deep cleaning projects, carpet cleaning, and specialized services. Assist with facility events, corporate functions, and special programs. Support small capital projects and equipment upgrades. Participate in facility improvement initiatives and workplace enhancement projects. Identify inefficiencies and recommend process improvements. Benchmark services against industry standards and best practices. Lead or support service optimization initiatives. Implement lessons learned and best practices from completed projects.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Education:** 
 Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Engineering Technology, Building Services, Business Administration, or related field. High school diploma with relevant technical and facility services experience may be considered.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\-7 years of experience in integrated facility services, combining soft services coordination with technical services support. Experience in commercial office buildings, corporate facilities, industrial sites, or multi\-tenant environments. Background in vendor coordination, service delivery operations, and performance monitoring. Demonstrated experience with governance, compliance monitoring, or quality assurance. Exposure to building systems maintenance and work order management. Customer service experience in a corporate or professional environment. Experience managing service level agreements and performance metrics.
   

  

**Technical Knowledge:** 
 Understanding of housekeeping operations, cleaning standards, and industry best practices. Familiarity with workplace services including reception, mail services, and amenity management. Basic technical knowledge of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and lighting. Understanding of preventive maintenance principles and equipment servicing requirements. Ability to interpret basic technical documentation, service reports, and maintenance logs. Knowledge of governance frameworks, SOP development, and quality management systems. Understanding of KPI development, performance monitoring, and reporting methodologies. Knowledge of health and safety requirements for facility and technical services. Proficiency with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) or CAFM platforms. Knowledge of inventory management and supplies coordination. Understanding of building automation systems and energy management concepts preferred.
   

  

**Governance \& Compliance Skills:** 
 Ability to develop and implement standard operating procedures and service standards. Experience conducting audits, inspections, and quality assessments. Strong documentation and record\-keeping capabilities. Understanding of compliance requirements and regulatory frameworks. Knowledge of vendor management best practices and contract administration. Familiarity with performance measurement and continuous improvement methodologies. Experience with reporting tools and dashboard creation. Understanding of statutory compliance requirements for building systems.
   

  

**Skills:** 
 Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels. Customer service orientation with analytical and problem\-solving mindset. Ability to coordinate multiple vendors and service providers simultaneously. Technical aptitude with ability to understand basic building systems and maintenance requirements. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), particularly Excel for data analysis and reporting. Report writing and documentation skills with ability to present findings clearly. Data analysis capabilities to identify trends and insights from performance metrics. Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. Professional demeanor and presentation skills. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and urgent requests. Process\-oriented thinking with focus on standardization and efficiency. Basic troubleshooting and problem diagnosis abilities.
   

  

 Personal Attributes
   

  

 Strong attention to detail and quality consciousness. Proactive approach with ability to anticipate needs and identify issues before escalation. Professional and courteous demeanor with all stakeholders. Team player with collaborative working style. Resilient and calm under pressure with strong problem\-solving abilities. Service\-minded with commitment to excellence and continuous improvement. Reliable and trustworthy with strong work ethic and integrity. Adaptable to changing environments and requirements. Analytical mindset with ability to translate data into actionable insights. Process\-driven with focus on standardization and best practices. Technical curiosity and willingness to learn about building systems. Decisive with ability to prioritize competing demands effectively.
   

  

 Working Conditions
   

  

 Standard business hours Monday to Saturday, with flexibility for early morning or evening service coordination. On\-call availability may be required for emergency technical or service issues. Occasional weekend work may be required for special events, audits, projects, or emergency response. Office\-based with significant time spent conducting facility inspections, vendor coordination, and documentation. Fast\-paced environment with multiple concurrent priorities requiring effective time management. Interaction with diverse stakeholders including occupants, vendors, management, technical contractors, and external auditors. May require flexibility for urgent service issues, technical emergencies, compliance matters, or occupant needs. Regular use of computers for documentation, reporting, and analysis. Exposure to mechanical rooms, plant areas, and technical environments.

title: EHS Executive
description:
**About us** 




  





 Umendra Life Sciences manufactures OTC topical pharmaceuticals and personal care products — creams, gels, lotions and ointments — primarily for the US and other international markets.
 



  





 We are looking to add an EHS Executive to our team.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will own day\-to\-day Environment, Health and Safety at the site — the shop floor version, not the head\-office version. That means being visibly present in operational areas, knowing the high\-risk jobs before they start, and having the standing to intervene when something isn't right. You'll work alongside production, maintenance, projects, HR and contractors.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Run the daily inspection rhythm — identify unsafe acts and conditions, drive corrective action to closure, and stay on it until it's closed.
* Own the permit\-to\-work system end\-to\-end: hot work, work at height, confined\-space entry, electrical isolation and other high\-risk activities.
* Lead risk assessments, Job Safety Analyses and toolbox talks so that hazard thinking sits with the line, not only with you.
* Investigate incidents, near misses and environmental events — root cause, CAPA, and verification that the fix held.
* Own emergency preparedness: response plans plus fire, evacuation, spill\-response and first\-aid drills that people actually take seriously.
* Deliver induction, refresher and contractor safety training, and hold contractors to the same standard as employees — from prequalification through on\-site supervision.
* Keep statutory compliance clean: registers, inspection records, testing and certification schedules, and direct interaction with regulators and external auditors.
* Manage environmental controls — waste segregation, hazardous\-waste handling, emissions, effluent, and energy and resource use.
* Drive implementation and continual improvement of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 at the site.
* Report what matters — weekly and monthly EHS dashboards, trend analysis and honest escalation to management.
* Build participation: safety observations, campaigns, suggestions and committee meetings that generate real input from the floor.



**Who fits** 




 Requirements, not preferences:
 


* Based at or willing to relocate to Ahmedabad, and able to work on\-site at our Bavla plant daily. This is a plant role — there is no remote or hybrid arrangement.
* 3–5 years of hands\-on EHS experience in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, engineering or construction. Plant floor exposure is essential; corporate or consulting\-only backgrounds won't translate.
* Recognized Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, meeting applicable statutory requirements, alongside a Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering, Science, Environmental Studies or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of Indian occupational safety, fire, environmental and waste\-management regulations.
* Direct experience running incident investigations, risk assessments, permit\-to\-work systems and emergency response.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, Hindi and Gujarati — you'll be explaining the same standard to a plant head and to a contract worker on the same day.



 Preferred: ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 internal auditor certification. First\-aid and fire\-safety certification. Pharmaceutical, cosmetic or chemical manufacturing background.
 



  





 What we're really looking for is judgment and persistence — the confidence to interrupt work that's unsafe, the credibility to be listened to when you do, and the patience to chase a corrective action until it's genuinely closed rather than merely logged.
 



**What this role is not** 



* Not a corporate or head\-office EHS position — you will spend most of your day in operational areas, not at a desk.
* Not remote or hybrid.
* Not a documentation\-only role. Records matter, but a candidate whose experience is limited to maintaining files and preparing audit paperwork will struggle here.
* Not a role where safety gets overruled by schedule pressure.



**How you'll be measured** 




 Recordable incidents and lost\-time injuries. Near\-miss reporting rates — we want these going up, not down. Closure rate and ageing of corrective actions. Completion of inspections, audits, training and drills. Contractor and permit compliance. Zero overdue statutory renewals. Reduction in repeat findings.

description:
**Job Title \- Mechanical Engineer**
**Location \- Pune**
**Job Summary**
 Working on both projects and bid proposals, the Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the mechanical design of piping and equipment systems, or parts thereof. The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for:
   

  

* developing a mechanical design which meets the requirements of the proposal or project
* ensuring design phase outputs are delivered in line with the time schedule and quality requirements
* providing technical support regarding mechanical design aspects throughout project and bid lifecycles
* undertaking other technical tasks as required (e.g. site surveys, feasibility studies, support to sales, etc)


 In general, the Mechanical Engineer will work as part of a team and will collaborate closely with other team members and functional disciplines to ensure successful delivery of the project or bid scope.
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
 The Mechanical Engineer’s duties include, but are not limited to the following:
   

  

**Mechanical Engineer**
 The primary role will be to undertake mechanical engineering design tasks on projects or proposals, including:
   

  

* Safety \& Environment
+ Ensuring that, with respect to the scope of works for which SPX Flow are responsible:
- Plant designs are safe
- Environmental impacts of our designs have been considered appropriately

+ Participating in relevant reviews, as defined in SPX Flow procedures and, additionally, customer contracts, and ensuring that her/his resultant actions have been completed. (Example reviews include: Design Reviews, Risk Assessments)
+ Ensuring compliance with local legislation and regulations (for the locality of the plant/process) which apply to engineering design
+ Acting in a safe fashion, particularly when operating outside of the known office environment (e.g. on customer and supplier sites)


* Mechanical Design Tasks
+ Generating process solutions and defining their characteristics in terms of:
- Equipment and fabricated item specifications (e.g. vessel specifications)
- Layout and elevational diagrams
- 2D \& 3D piping diagrams
- Dimensioned manufacturing diagrams (e.g. skidded system designs, pipe support structures)
- Material lists
- Loading/foundation requirements
- Transportation, ingress, egress and maintenance access requirements
- Creating purchase requisitions of materials (using SAP)

+ Adhering to SPX Flow procedures, and utilising applicable tools and design standards, during the development of mechanical designs
+ Completing design calculations (e.g. loadings, stress calculations, thermal expansion etc) to support mechanical design and equipment selection
+ Ensuring that tasks are completed in accordance with the project schedule, to the required quality and within the allocated budget.


* Design Ownership
+ Ensuring that the design, for which they are responsible, is functional, and is executed in line with:
- Applicable legislation and regulation
- Customer contractual requirements (or, in case of proposal, RFQ/URS requirements)
- SPX references, standards and best practices, where applicable

+ Ensuring that design output is complete and of a consistent standard. Examples include:
- Skids and manifold drawings
- Platform drawings

+ Ensuring all scope elements/sub\-systems for which they are responsible integrate coherently and that external interfaces are clearly understood and defined
+ Considering economic factors with a view to ensuring that the overall project is delivered on budget
+ Ensuring that the design is ergonomically efficient


* Communication \& Team Working
+ Undertaking technical discussions with customers and suppliers
+ Attending relevant project or proposal meetings e.g.:
- Launch/ “kick\-off” meetings
- Progress reviews
- Design reviews

+ Communicating information to stakeholders in a timely fashion
+ Supporting other disciplines, during the design phase, to achieve project or proposal deliverables e.g.
- Supply Chain (e.g. initial specification, review of supplier quotes, purchase requisitions, etc)
- Process design (e.g. interpreting P\&ID requirements)
- Electrical design (e.g. agreeing panel positions and cable runs)

+ Supporting Installation \& Commissioning team during the site execution phase e.g.:
- communicating design intent
- assisting with planning of equipment ingress/positioning
- highlighting critical installation requirements
- assisting with resolution of design issues

+ Assisting with hand\-over of design information to Aftermarket team


* Documentation
+ Ensuring that all design information is captured, stored and maintained, in the allocated location, in a structured and accessible fashion
+ Assisting in compilation of Technical Files, or equivalent


  

  

* Additional Sales Support \& Proposals Tasks
+ Attending pre\-contact customer meetings to provide technical support to the sales team
+ Undertaking pre\-contract studies (e.g. feasibility, site surveys)


**Lead Engineer**
**Responsibilities**
 On a given project or proposal, the Mechanical Engineer may be allocated the role of “Lead Engineer”. In this capacity, they will be expected to lead a multi\-disciplinary team to deliver the overall design outputs for the scope package for which they are responsible. In this capacity, they will be responsible for additional tasks such as:
   

  

* Establishing and leading engineering team meetings/discussions
* Generating and maintaining time schedule for the engineering phase
* Identifying and communicating resource needs
* Actively managing team members to meet schedule demands and target on\-budget execution (in terms of hours), whilst still ensuring delivery of a thoroughly engineered, complete design.
* Establishing and communicating consistent design and documentation standards for the project/proposal
* Ensuring that required reviews and meetings (e.g. design reviews) are completed and that resultant actions are closed out by the team.
* Ensuring team compliance with SPX Flow processes and procedures


 E
 **ngineering Community Member**
 As a Member Of The Global Engineering Team, The Mechanical Engineer Will Be Expected To Actively Participate In The Wider Technical Community And Provide Support To Colleagues, Including
   

  

* General Technical Support


* 
+ Supporting other staff in areas where they are inexperienced
+ Providing general technical support outside of the specific projects/proposals for which they are responsible. Examples include:
- Conceptual design guidance during proposal stage


* Continuous Improvement
+ Providing input into continuous improvement initiatives (e.g. tools development, standardisation)
+ Documenting and communicating “lessons learned”
+ Involvement in knowledge sharing initiatives (e.g. documenting best practices)


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Extensive experience with Autodesk AutoCAD modelling and drafting
* Extensive experience with Autodesk Inventor modelling and drafting
* Extensive experience with Autodesk Plant 3D modelling and drafting
* Experience with document management system Vault and version control and lifecycle in the same system
* Good level of competence in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Knowledge of stainless\-steel tank or fabricated equipment design in a hygienic or similar industry (food, dairy, sugar, brewing/distilling)
* Good knowledge of material and piping standards (e.g. ASME, DIN, ISO)
* Fluent English – both spoken and written
* Good communication skills
* Ability to work on multiple tasks, within a matrix environment
* Ability and willingness to work and build relationships with colleagues across multiple functions and geographically diverse sites
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good initiative and ability to work independently
* The ability to meet high performance standards in a team whilst maintaining ethics and integrity
* Health, Safety \& Environmental Awareness with respect to design usability
* SAP experiences beneficial


**Education And Experience**
* Degree level qualification in appropriate engineering discipline (e.g. Mechanical)
* Engineering design experience minimum of 5\-10 years, preferably in Food, Beverage, Pharmaceutical and/or other hygienic industries
* Understanding of sanitary design principles as applied to design of piping systems and associated process equipment
* Experience / understanding of systems designed for clean\-in\-place (CIP)
* Experience / understanding of fabricated equipment (e.g. vessels, heat exchangers)
* Full driving license is a strong advantage


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**
 In general, this is an office\-based job with a considerable amount of time spent at a computer. Ability to travel to other SPX locations and customer sites is a requirement. On some occasions, extended working away from the office may be required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS**
 Ability to travel globally and locally up to approximately 30% of the time.
   

  

 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**SPX FLOW VALUES**
 SPX Flow employees are expected to behave in accordance with our company values as outlined below.
   

  

**QUALITY**
 Quality encompasses all aspects of SPX’s business, and every employee shares the responsibility to prevent the occurrence of any nonconformity relating to product, process and the quality system. All employees have an obligation to identify and record any such nonconformity, and through designed channels, initiate and recommend solutions.

description:
DDN is seeking great candidates to join our dynamic team of passionate customer\-enabling technologists!This is an incredible opportunity to be part of a company that has been at the forefront of AI and high\-performance data storage innovation for over two decades. DDN Storage is a global market leader renowned for powering many of the world's most demanding AI data centers, in industries ranging from life sciences and healthcare to financial services, autonomous cars, Government, academia, research and manufacturing
   

  

**"DDN's A3I solutions are transforming the landscape of AI infrastructure." – IDC**
***“The real differentiator is DDN. I never hesitate to recommend DDN. DDN is the de facto name for AI Storage in high performance environments” \- \~ Marc Hamilton***
***VP, Solutions Architecture \& Engineering \| NVIDIA***
 DDN is the global leader in AI and multi\-cloud data management at scale. Our cutting\-edge storage and data management solutions are designed to accelerate AI workloads, enabling organizations to extract maximum value from their data. With a proven track record of performance, reliability, and scalability, DDN Storage empowers businesses to tackle the most challenging AI and data\-intensive workloads with confidence.
   

  

 Our success is driven by our unwavering commitment to innovation, customer\-centricity, and a team of passionate professionals who bring their expertise and dedication to every project. This is a chance to make a significant impact at a company that is shaping the future of AI and data management.
   

  

 Our commitment to innovation, customer success, and market leadership makes this an exciting and rewarding role for a driven professional looking to make a lasting impact in the world of AI and data storage.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a
 **Staff Engineer – L4** 
 , you’ll be an escalation point for the most complex and critical issues affecting enterprise and hyperscale environments. This hands\-on role is ideal for a deep technical expert who thrives under pressure and has a passion for solving distributed system challenges at scale. This role is part of the Infinia Core engineering team.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Field teams to drive root cause resolutions, define architectural best practices, and continuously improve product resiliency. Leveraging
 **AI tools** 
 and automation, you’ll reduce time\-to\-resolution, streamline diagnostics, and elevate the support experience for strategic customers.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Technical Expertise \& Escalation LeadershipOwn critical customer case escalations end\-to\-end, including deep root cause analysis and mitigation strategies.
* Act as one of the technical escalation points for Infinia incidents — especially in productionimpacting scenarios.
* Lead war rooms, live incident bridges, and cross\-functional response efforts with other engineering, QA, and Field teams.
* Utilize AI\-powered debugging, log analysis, and system pattern recognition tools to accelerate resolution.


 Product Knowledge \& Value Creation
   

  

* Become a subject\-matter expert on Infinia internals: metadata handling, storage fabric interfaces, performance tuning, AI integration, etc.
* Reproduce complex customer issues and propose product improvements or workarounds.
* Author and maintain detailed runbooks, performance tuning guides, and RCA documentation.
* Feed real\-world support insights back into the development cycle to improve reliability and diagnostics.


 Customer Engagement \& Business Enablement
   

  

* Partner with Field CTOs, Solutions Architects, and Sales Engineers to ensure customer success.
* Translate technical issues into executive\-ready summaries and business impact statements.
* Participate in post\-mortems and executive briefings for strategic accounts.
* Drive adoption of observability, automation, and self\-healing support mechanisms using AI/ML tools.
* Delivering training to customer support and field engineering


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years in enterprise storage, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure support/engineering.
* Deep understanding of file systems (S3, POSIX, NFS), storage performance, and Linux kernel internals.
* Scripting and Coding using Python, Go, C\+\+
* Proven debugging skills at system/protocol/app levels (e.g., strace, tcpdump, perf).
* Hands\-on experience with troubleshooting on Linux.
* Exposure to RDMA, NVMe\-oF, or high\-performance networking stacks.
* Exceptional communication and executive reporting skills.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., log pattern analysis, LLM\-based summarisation, automated RCA tooling) to accelerate diagnostics and reduce MTTR.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with DDN, VAST, Weka, or similar scale\-out file systems.
* Strong scripting/coding ability in Python, Bash, or Go.
* Familiarity with observability platforms: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry.
* Knowledge of replication, consistency models, and data integrity mechanisms.
* Exposure to Sovereign AI, LLM model training environments, or autonomous system data architectures.
* This position requires participation in an on\-call rotation to provide after\-hours support as needed.


 Success Metrics – First 30 Days
   

  

 Technical Ramp\-Up
   

  

* Complete Infinia training, labs, and architecture deep dives. o Stand up a fully functioning Infinia test system. o Shadow at least 5 complex escalations and participate in 2 customer calls.


 Operational Integration
   

  

* Lead one live incident response and deliver a full RCA within 48 hours. o Propose 3\+ enhancements to internal tools, AI/automation usage, or documentation. o Establish key partnerships with Engineering and Field teams.


 Strategic Insight
   

  

* Deliver a written 30\-day reflection with gaps and high\-impact recommendations. o Begin identifying patterns where AI or automation can reduce MTTR or improve proactive detection.


**Success Metrics – Beyond 30 Days**
* MTTR on high\-severity cases is consistently below internal SLAs.
* Volume and quality of resolved L4 escalations.
* Strategic tooling or automation contributions adopted across the support org.
* Executive\-ready RCAs that inform product improvement.
* High\-impact engagements with strategic accounts (prevention, performance tuning, etc.).

description:
**Department:**

**Location:**

**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands\-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence\-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.


**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
 Essential Skills \& Experience
   

  

* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53\.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.

 We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands\-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence\-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53\.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Experience in financial services, capital markets or another regulated industry is highly regarded.


**Benefits**
**Compensation:**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies.  We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical
 **Senior Researcher**
