This is an opportunity to play a leading role in shaping construction market intelligence across global markets. You will work on complex research programmes, engage with senior stakeholders and contribute to strategic decision\-making across some of the world's most dynamic construction sectors.  This role will lead the development of construction market research and insights across key sectors such as data centres, life sciences, high\-tech industrial and commercial. The successful candidate will manage research projects from inception to completion, analyse complex datasets, identify market trends, develop evidence\-based viewpoints and provide strategic insights that support business and client decision\-making.
   

  

 The role requires strong analytical capability, commercial awareness, critical thinking and communication skills. Beyond data collection and analysis, the successful candidate will be expected to interpret findings, challenge assumptions, identify implications and communicate clear conclusions through high\-quality client\-facing deliverables.
   

  

**The Opportunity**

* Collect, analyse and interpret market data relating to labour, materials, project costs, procurement, supply chains and construction activity
* Produce market intelligence reports, insight papers and thought leadership content that help clients and internal teams understand market conditions, risks and opportunities
* Develop market assessments, benchmarking studies and sector analyses across data centres, life sciences, high\-tech industrial and commercial

* Demonstrate the ability to apply critical thinking, challenge assumptions and develop evidence\-based viewpoints
* Have experience in delivering research projects from inception to completion, including research design, data collection, analysis and reporting

* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop high\-quality reports, presentations and client\-facing deliverables

* Familiarity with data automation, dashboard development and advanced analytical tools

title: Creative Video Editor & Videographer

 Hyderabad

 1–4 Years

 ₹35,000–₹90,000 per month, based on skills and experience
 


 About the Role
 
 We’re looking for a
 **Creative Video Editor \& Videographer** 
 to join our in\-house content team and help build a strong, organic\-first real estate media presence. You’ll work closely with our founders, content team, and creators to transform raw footage into
 **engaging, high\-retention videos** 
 that educate, entertain, and build trust, while bringing strong storytelling and creative thinking to content across Instagram, YouTube, and other short\-form platforms.
 


 What You’ll Do
 * **Edit** 
 high\-quality Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and long\-form videos, transforming raw footage into engaging, story\-driven content.
* **Create compelling visual narratives** 
 using strong hooks, pacing, creative cuts, B\-roll, sound design, music, transitions, and visual effects to improve retention.

 , including kinetic typography, animated text, maps, charts, callouts, and other graphics that enhance the content.

 to understand the objective and audience of each video, while contributing creative ideas for scripts, hooks, shots, and storytelling.

 , including participating in shoots, repurposing long\-form content, maintaining brand consistency, organizing assets, and delivering content within deadlines.

 , including motion graphics and visual effects.

 , with an excellent sense of pacing, storytelling, visual composition, typography, subtitles, and on\-screen graphics.
* **Strong B\-roll, sound\-design, and music\-selection skills** 
 , with an understanding of how to use visual and audio elements creatively.

 , with the ability to work efficiently, take feedback, contribute ideas, and make

 The Ideal Candidate
 
 You understand that a good video isn’t necessarily the one with the most effects. You know when to make a cut, when to hold a shot, when to add B\-roll or motion graphics, and when to keep things simple. You understand

 , and actively study successful creators and content formats to understand what makes people stop scrolling. title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Chenab Impex Pvt. Ltd. is a pioneer in importing gourmet foods and beverages, bringing fine foods to the Indian market since 2002 under the motto “enriching the flavour of life.” The company sources and distributes a diverse range of premium products from around the world, including olive oils, vinegars, pasta, cereals, cheeses, jams, honey, canned fish, and wines. With a sales network that spans across India.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Remote / Mumbai preferred, but not essential
 


 About Chenab Gourmet
 
 Chenab Gourmet is an online gourmet food store offering premium ingredients and speciality foods from around the world. Our range includes Italian, Asian, Mexican, Mediterranean and baking ingredients, along with premium pantry products from leading international brands.
 



 We’re looking for an experienced
 **SEO specialist** 
 to help us grow Chenab Gourmet’s organic search presence and turn SEO into a meaningful acquisition channel for the business.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. We’re looking for someone who can identify opportunities, build the SEO roadmap and execute it, rather than only provide audits or recommendations.
 



  




 What you’ll work on
 
 You’ll be responsible for improving organic visibility and traffic across our website, particularly for commercially relevant searches around products, ingredients, cuisines, recipes and brands.
 



 Your responsibilities will include:
 


* Conducting SEO audits and identifying high\-impact opportunities
* Building and managing an SEO roadmap
* Keyword research and mapping keywords to category, product, brand and content pages
* Improving category and collection pages for high\-intent commercial searches
* Optimising product pages, titles, meta descriptions, headings, copy and internal linking
* Identifying opportunities to create new landing pages based on search demand
* Improving site architecture and internal linking
* Technical SEO, including crawlability, indexing, canonicals, redirects, sitemaps and duplicate content issues
* Implementing or recommending structured data/schema where relevant
* Working with our content team on SEO\-led articles, recipes, guides and other content
* Refreshing existing content where there is potential to improve rankings
* Competitor and content\-gap analysis
* Supporting backlink and domain\-authority building initiatives
* Monitoring Google Search Console, GA4 and SEO tools to identify opportunities and problems
* Tracking rankings, organic traffic, conversions and revenue from organic search
* Providing a concise monthly report showing what was done, what changed and what should happen next


- 

 What we care about
 
 We’re particularly interested in someone who understands
 **e\-commerce SEO** 
 .
 



 The goal isn’t simply to increase traffic. We want to rank for searches that can lead to product discovery and purchases.
 



 This could include searches around:
 


* specific ingredients and products
* cuisine\-related ingredients
* premium and imported food products
* brands we distribute
* recipes where our products are relevant
* comparison, substitution and “where to buy” searches



 You should be able to think about search intent and understand when a query is better served by a category page, product page, buying guide, recipe or article.
 



  




 You’d be a strong fit if you have
 * **1\+ year of hands\-on SEO experience**
* Some experience working on e\-commerce websites
* A good understanding of technical, on\-page and content SEO
* Experience using Google Search Console and GA4
* Familiarity with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar
* Strong keyword research and search\-intent analysis skills
* An understanding of internal linking, site structure and on\-page optimisation
* The ability to prioritise work based on likely SEO and commercial impact
* Good written English and attention to detail
* The ability to work independently and execute rather than only make recommendations



 We’re open to someone relatively early in their SEO career if they can demonstrate strong fundamentals, curiosity and examples of work they’ve actually done.
 



 Experience with food, FMCG, gourmet retail or other e\-commerce businesses would be useful, but isn’t essential.
 



  




 What success looks like
 
 Over time, we’d expect to see:
 


* Growth in non\-branded organic search traffic
* Increased visibility for commercially relevant keywords
* More category and product pages ranking organically
* Growth in organic sessions that lead to purchases
* Better indexing and technical site health
* Increased organic revenue


- 

 Engagement
 
 This is a
 **part\-time contractual role** 
 with the potential for an ongoing engagement.
 



 The workload will be based primarily on agreed deliverables rather than fixed office hours. You’ll work closely with our internal marketing/content team and coordinate with our website developers where technical changes are required.
 



  




 To apply
 
 Please send:
 


1. A short introduction and your relevant SEO experience
2. Examples of websites you’ve worked on, ideally e\-commerce
3. 1–2 examples of SEO work you’ve done and the result
4. The SEO tools you regularly use
5. Your expected monthly fee / retainer
6. Your approximate availability each week



**Please don’t send a generic SEO proposal.** 
 Have a look at Chenab Gourmet and tell us one or two SEO opportunities you notice on the website.

 , bringing together content distribution, social\-first media properties, and creator/talent partnerships under one roof. The idea is to build owned or co\-owned media and creator\-led brands — properties with their own audience, voice, and distribution engine that stand on their own, not simply a service line delivering client work. Think publisher\-style or creator\-first media brands that generate their own attention, community, and monetization independent of any single client mandate.
   

  

 We're looking for someone to
 **lead and build this pod from the ground up** 
 defining its shape, hiring the team, setting up the operating model, and owning its P\&L and growth. This is a builder's role: equal parts strategist, operator, and hands\-on leader.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Pod strategy \& build\-out — define the pod's charter, revenue model, and roadmap; decide what gets built in\-house vs. partnered vs. acquired
* Team building — hire and structure the pod (content, distribution, creator partnerships, ops) as it scales from founding team to full function
* Distribution strategy — grow owned channels and audience across platforms (Instagram, YouTube, X, emerging platforms); own the playbook for what makes content travel
* Events — build IRL/experiential touchpoints as an extension of the pod's owned properties, driving community and additional monetization
* Creator ecosystem — build and manage a creator/talent network — sourcing, partnerships, negotiations, and long\-term relationships with creators relevant to the pod's audience
* Revenue \& P\&L — own the pod's revenue and EBITDA targets; identify and close monetization opportunities (brand partnerships, licensing, creator deals, owned IP)
* Cross\-pod collaboration — work closely with HotCult's other pods (solutioning, creative, strategy) to identify synergies — e.g., distribution support for client work, creator access for brand campaigns
* Reporting \& accountability — represent the pod in leadership reviews; be accountable for outcomes, not just activity


**Culture, the Hotcult Way**
 This Pod Isn't Just a Distribution/monetization Play — It's An Extension Of How Hotcult Already Reads And Builds Culture, Applied To Owned Properties Instead Of Client Briefs. A Few Things That Should Carry Over
   

  

* Culture\-reading as the core skill, not an add\-on. Hotcult's methodology reads culture through History, Present, and Future Signal — understanding where a cultural thread has come from, what's happening with it now, and where it's heading next. The pod head should apply this same lens to pick what to build, when to build it, and when a trend has run its course — not chase virality reactively.
* Owned brands should feel native to a scene, not manufactured for reach. The same instinct Hotcult brings to reading South Indian regional culture for client work — specificity over generic pan\-India content — should shape what these properties sound and look like. Distribution strategy should be built around genuine cultural fluency in the spaces the pod chooses to own, not just platform best practices.
* Creator relationships as long\-term culture partnerships, not transactional deals. In line with how Hotcult approaches brand\-culture fit, creator sourcing and partnerships should be judged on whether the creator's voice is authentically aligned with what the pod is building — not just reach or price.
* Integration, not a silo. Even though this pod builds its own IP and revenue line, it should stay porous with the rest of Hotcult — sharing culture intelligence back into solutioning and creative (what's trending, what's landing, what's fading), and drawing on the agency's existing cultural research and client\-work learnings rather than rebuilding that knowledge from scratch.


**What We're Looking For**
* 7\-8 years of experience across media, content, or creator economy — ideally with direct experience building or scaling a media/distribution brand or creator business
* Strong grasp of platform mechanics and what drives distribution/virality across short\-form and long\-form content
* Existing relationships in the creator/influencer ecosystem are a strong plus
* Comfortable owning a P\&L and being measured on revenue and EBITDA, not just output
* Entrepreneurial mindset — this role has founder\-like latitude and founder\-like accountability
* Strong people leadership — you'll be hiring and building a team, not just doing the work yourself

title: Videographer & Video Editor
description:
**About Us** 




 We are a leading ethnic fashion brand with a strong legacy and a growing omnichannel presence. With an extensive network of stores across India and a rapidly expanding online business through our own e\-commerce platform, we serve customers both domestically and internationally. Our product portfolio includes sarees, jewellery, kidswear, and other ethnic wear categories, backed by a commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and exceptional customer experience.
 



 As we continue to scale our digital presence, we are focused on creating engaging visual content that brings our products, brand, and stories to life across digital and social media platforms.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 We are looking for a
 **Videographer \& Video Editor** 
 to create high\-quality, engaging video content for our digital and social media platforms. This is a hands\-on creative role involving end\-to\-end video production — from conceptualization and shooting to editing and final delivery.
 



 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of visual storytelling, fashion and product presentation, and short\-form digital content. The role requires someone who can independently handle shoots, experiment with creative formats, and produce visually appealing content that aligns with the brand's identity and marketing objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Plan, shoot, and produce high\-quality video content for Instagram, YouTube, website, and other digital platforms.
* Handle end\-to\-end video production, including camera setup, lighting, framing, shooting, and basic sound recording.
* Edit short\-form and long\-form videos, including Instagram Reels, promotional videos, product videos, and campaign content.
* Create engaging videos that effectively showcase sarees, jewellery, kidswear, and other ethnic wear categories.
* Work closely with the creative and marketing teams to develop content concepts and translate ideas into compelling visual stories.
* Ensure videos are edited according to platform\-specific formats, trends, and audience preferences.
* Add music, transitions, text, graphics, colour correction, and other elements to enhance the overall quality of the content.
* Maintain consistency in visual style, brand guidelines, and overall content quality.
* Manage and organize raw footage, project files, and final video assets.
* Stay updated with emerging video trends, editing techniques, and social media content formats.
* Coordinate with models, stylists, content creators, and internal teams during shoots.
* Ensure timely delivery of video content as per the content calendar and campaign requirements.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* 2–4 years of experience in Videography, Video Editing, Content Creation, or a similar role.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating videography and video editing skills, preferably in fashion, retail, lifestyle, or D2C/e\-commerce.
* Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools.
* Good understanding of camera equipment, lighting, composition, framing, and visual storytelling.
* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, short\-form content, and current social media video trends.
* Creative mindset with strong attention to detail and visual aesthetics.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple content requirements simultaneously.

title: Wings- Fly Again with Fedex
description:
Aligned to FedEx commitment towards diversity, “WINGS, Fly Again with FedEx is an inclusive hiring initiative designed to attract, hire, and integrate women professionals returning from career breaks into meaningful roles at FedEx. The program focuses on skills, competency, and role fit, while providing a supportive and structured pathway back into the workforce.
   

  

 This initiative strengthens workforce diversity while leveraging experienced talent to drive measurable business impact.
   

  

 Aligned to FedEx commitment towards diversity, “WINGS", Fly Again with FedEx is an inclusive hiring initiative designed to attract, hire, and integrate women professionals returning from career breaks into meaningful roles at FedEx. The program focuses on skills, competency, and role fit, while providing a supportive and structured pathway back into the workforce.
   

  

 This initiative strengthens workforce diversity while leveraging experienced talent to drive measurable business impact.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 At FedEx, moving the world doesn’t only mean delivering for our customers around the globe. Moving the world is also about creating what’s next. We are Team FedEx consists of 500,000\+ people strong around the world. The work we all do comes down to one purpose: to provide our customers with outstanding experiences as we connect the world to what’s next.
   

  

 This isn’t a place to get just a job, here you get a career for life. It’s a place to enjoy constant change, growth, and progress in your career. Our willingness to innovate and transform is what keeps us at the forefront of our industry. With curiosity, inventiveness, and entrepreneurial spirit, we keep finding new and better ways to deliver results – for our customers, for our people and for the planet.
   

  

 Here you will be given the flexibility and the empowerment to reimagine the new, spread your wings and see your impact. By doing so, we are motivated to be better together. And together, we always manage to drive and deliver excellence.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Our culture values empower us to deliver great results. With one FedEx culture, we:
   

  

 Take care of each other \| Commit to do good \| Own outstanding \| Drive business results \| Create what’s next
   

  

**Awards**
* FedEx was ranked No. 18 on Fortune’s “World’s Most Admired Companies” All\-Star List in January 2026, marking its 26th consecutive year in the top 20\. FedEx remains the highest\-ranked delivery company on the list.
* Ethisphere named FedEx as one of Worlds Most Ethical Companies in 2023,2024 and 2025
* FedEx in India is Great Place To Work® Certified (2025\-2026\)


**What We Are Looking For**
* Women with prior corporate experience (3\+ years)
* Career break duration of 1–5\+ years
* Professionals looking for a second career opportunity without compromise on role relevance or merit
* Minimum graduate qualification required (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills


**What You Can Expect To Get**
* Salary as per agreed compensation structure
* Tuition Assistance
* Incentives (Bonus / AIC)
* Great Working Environment
* Spread your wings and take ownership of your career with opportunities to advance through internal promotions, job rotations, and cross\-functional projects.
* Complimentary 24/7 access to our learning platforms to support you in becoming who you want to be
* Work\-life balance programs including hybrid work arrangement. WFH (work from home) and office
* Health \& wellness, employee assistance, and rewards and recognition programs
* Special employee discounts on shipping, travel, and much more


**Interested?**
 Everyone at FedEx has a part to play. It’s about coming up with smart solutions, remaining resilient in the face of setbacks, and going above and beyond to get the job done. And whether you’re a business leader or delivery driver, you’ll be empowered to take responsibility and overcome each challenge in your own way.
   

  

 If this position and working environment sound like the right fit for you, then do no wait and please apply today.
   

  

 Search Jobs \| FedEx Careers
   

  

 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Senior Consultant - Middleware/OCP
description:
**About The Job**
 The Red Hat India Services team is looking for a Consultant to join us in Mumbai, India. In this role, you will help us ensure that our engagements are not just a technology implementation, but an organizational transformation. As a consultant, you will work with our lead architect in our engagements, cocreating innovative software solutions using emerging open source technology and modern software design methods in an agile environment. You’ll be coached by the team to facilitate the design and technical delivery of our solutions. As you do so, you’ll create enthusiasm for building great software using principles of open source and agile culture. You'll support everything from the scoping to delivering the engagements. Successful applicants must reside in a city where Red Hat has mentioned the location.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Applies software engineering principles to the operations domain.
* Ensures service reliability meets users’ needs, including internally critical and externally visible services
* Uses software \& systems engineering to design, build, and run large\-scale, distributed, fault\-tolerant systems
* Develop API’s using Red Hat technology products and service
* Design, develop, and manage Kafka\-based data pipelines
* Provide issue analysis on Kafka applications
* Monitor Kafka performance and troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and ensure uninterrupted data flow, enhancing decision\-making and operational efficiency.
* Participates in an on\-call rotation within a geographically distributed team to provide 24x7x365 production support, with responsibility to respond to urgent customer issues
* Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems
* Help us cover domains including microservices, API management, and web\-scale architectures, DevOps engineering and application delivery, container\-based continuous delivery (CD), i.e., using Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform,
* Team up with Red Hat and the open source community to engineer innovation\-based software solutions, designed to further accelerate our customers’ success at their transformation journey
* Work as a trusted adviser to our customers and use your critical thinking skills to tackle tough problems in an innovative way
* Train and coach team members both on technical and non\-technical skills
* Remain an active coder as this is required during our engagements and maintain deep direct technical knowledge of container management systems (CMSs), application infrastructure, architectures, and development solutions
* Support presales and post\-sales field teams during workshops, proofs of concepts, pilots, and production deployments


**What You Will Bring**
* 5\+ years of experience and advanced knowledge of middleware technologies, including enterprise web or middleware development project experience with application integration
* Knowledge and some experience in OpenShift by Red Hat;
* Experience with another Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS) solution will also be considered
* Hands on experience using Cloud as a development environment
* JEE and Middleware technology
* Good technical skills and experience designing and implementing JEE solutions.
* Thorough experience with at least one of the major middleware solutions, preferably Red Hat JBoss Middleware; experience in Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, WebMethods, Tibco, etc. will also be considered.
* Hands on experience in application development with Agile approach
* Hands on experience on building pipelines and CI/CD.
* Knowledge on Devops and Microservices
* Enterprise Java development skills are an advantage.
* Knowledge of Hibernate and Tomcat is an advantage.
* Hands\-on experience on AMQ, API management like 3scale.
* Ability and desire to learn new technologies on your own and apply new concepts to problems


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with or knowledge of Red Hat’s technologies like Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, Red Hat Fuse, Red Hat 3Scale, Red Hat AMQ, or Red Hat AMQ Streams (Kafka)
* Working with some community technologies like Argo CD, Tekton Pipelines, Helm, or Jenkins
* Working with application and infrastructure monitoring
* Experience with or knowledge of JavaScript, Golang, Python, or Shell Scripting
* Experience with or knowledge of technologies AngularJS, React.js, and Vue.js


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. **About The Team**
 In 2024, Workday launched the Enterprise Data and Analytics (ED\&A) team with a mission to transform and optimize the way Workday creates and shares trusted data to drive actionable insights and data\-led innovation across the enterprise.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a DataOps Engineer, you own the end\-to\-end delivery and operational uptime of ED\&A infrastructure projects. You drive the alignment between complex technical requirements and business outcomes, ensuring that cloud\-native automation solutions are built to spec and on time. Operating with technical autonomy, you serve as a master practitioner of DataOps, leading engineering squads through complex sprints while proactively identifying and mitigating delivery risks.
   

  

 You act as a catalyst for modern craft within the infrastructure lifecycle, designing and refining AI\-augmented workflows to boost system quality and throughput. You build the automated structures necessary to support AI\-enabled data workloads, utilizing advanced co\-pilots to eliminate manual environment tracking and scale functional execution capacity.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Technical Delivery: Own the end\-to\-end configuration, platform delivery, and deployment architectures for data infrastructure and orchestration pipelines across Snowflake, Fivetran, and dbt tracks. Drive cloud platform administration independently using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to provision, scale, and govern cloud environments safely across deployment targets.
* Knowledge Management: Architect and mandate modular documentation frameworks across multiple shared repositories. Ensure all active environments, pipeline rules, and system configurations are fully audited and visible across engineering nodes.
* Incident Response \& Operational Resilience: Own operational uptime and proactive risk mitigation for core data environments. Build advanced pipeline health observability patterns inside Acceldata to capture anomalies and eliminate platform downtime processing risks.
* Agile Operational Facilitation: Lead multi\-disciplinary technical squads through complex engineering sprints. Manage pipeline release cadences independently, balance environment resource constraints, and resolve cross\-functional roadblock metrics.
* ED\&A Methodologies: Operationalize and enforce DataOps validation frameworks natively across continuous integration pipelines, ensuring the infrastructure framework cleanly yields certified datasets to support enterprise agentic AI readiness.
* AI Productivity: Design, refine, and embed automated AI\-augmented validation workflows, code refactoring templates, and agentic prompting chains inside your own workspace environment to maximize team capacity and delivery speed.


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of experience in Development Operations or Data Engineering with a focus on cloud\-native automation.
* Proficient in managing complex workstreams using GitHub, Jira, and Smartsheet.
* Proven track record of delivering technical projects in a multinational SaaS environment.


**Other Qualifications:**
* Modern Data Stack \& Cloud Foundations: Deep working knowledge of Snowflake data architectures, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Fivetran connectivity patterns, and dbt transformation networks to design resilient data movement loops and govern multi\-team CI/CD environments. Hands\-on experience or familiarity with GitHub Actions, Snowflake, Fivetran, Sigma, and Atlan (or similar enterprise data platforms) is preferred.
* AI\-Native Development \& Ops: Personal mastery of rapid automation prototyping, unit\-test automation, and syntax refactoring utilizing Cursor or GitHub Copilot, balanced with design pattern fluency in modern LLM orchestration frameworks.
* Data Governance \& Observability: Advanced command of metadata classification frameworks within Atlan or similar tools and deep metric configuration experience utilizing modern data observability platforms to manage automated environment visibility, trace data lineage, and enforce data trust boundaries.
* Operational Communication \& Collaboration: Strong communication and cross\-functional alignment skills, uniquely equipped to navigate operational ambiguity, guide technical decisions for engineering pods, and resolve data product constraints across partner domains.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply

* Hybrid work environment with flexibility to work from approved Rockwell Automation locations across India

title: Specialist - Economic Research & Advisory (R-19747)
description:
**Shape the Future with Dun \& Bradstreet** 



  



 At Dun \& Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at 
 
 dnb.com/careers
 
 .
 




  





 The Specialist Economist will be responsible for delivering high\-quality impact assessment reports, white papers, policy research, and revenue\-generating research studies. The incumbent will independently drive Economic and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) engagements, ensuring methodological rigor, analytical excellence, and timely delivery. The role involves conducting primary and secondary research, performing quantitative and qualitative analysis, developing actionable insights, and preparing client\-ready reports and presentations.
 


  


 The individual will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, clients, policymakers, and industry participants to understand business requirements, provide evidence\-based recommendations, and contribute to thought leadership initiatives that support client objectives and business growth.
 


  


  
 


  


 Work Location: 4 days a week from the BKC, Mumbai office and 1 day a week from the Turbhe, Navi Mumbai office.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities:** 
  
* Serve as the primary interface for internal sales teams and external stakeholders to drive growth in Economic Impact Assessment, Social Impact Assessment, CSR Impact Assessment, and Policy Evaluation services. Lead client discussions, identify and qualify opportunities, develop tailored proposals and methodologies, support solutioning, and convert prospects into long\-term client engagements.
  
* Lead the end\-to\-end execution of impact assessment mandates, including research design, data collection, stakeholder consultations, economic and social impact modelling, policy analysis, report writing, quality assurance, and client presentations. Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality, insight\-driven reports and actionable recommendations that meet client and stakeholder expectations.
  
* Deliver in\-depth macroeconomic and microeconomic analyses, offering a 360° perspective on India's growth trajectory, policy developments, and economic risks in a timely manner. Assess structural trends across key sectors such as agriculture, manufacturing, services, infrastructure, and the financial ecosystem, producing white papers and articles that offer unique insights.
  
* Design and implement robust systems and models to forecast critical economic indicators, including GDP, inflation, trade balances, fiscal metrics, and sector\-specific trends. Utilize advanced quantitative techniques to support predictive analytics and scenario building.
  
* Leverage large datasets to uncover economic patterns and trends. Maintain, enhance, and validate complex economic databases, ensuring data integrity and accuracy to support analytical outputs.
  
* Lead comprehensive sectoral studies covering rural consumption, production efficiencies, supply chain dynamics, credit flows, external trade, and financial market trends. Identify emerging risks and opportunities at both macro and micro levels.
  
* Develop high\-quality whitepapers, policy briefs, and opinion pieces that influence stakeholders across industries, financial institutions, and government bodies. Represent the group in internal \& external forums, client briefings, media interactions, and time\-critical insight requests, positioning the firm as a trusted voice on Indian economic matters.
  
* Deliver timely, high\-impact analyses on key economic events, data releases, and policy changes, ensuring that clients receive quick, responsive, and actionable insights.
  
* Provide bespoke economic insights tailored to client needs, including risk assessments, investment analyses, and strategic recommendations. Engage directly with clients to present findings, address queries, and offer consultative expertise.
  



  




**Key Requirements:** 
  
* Advanced degree in Economics (Master’s or Ph.D.) with a strong foundation in macroeconomics, econometrics, and quantitative analysis.
  
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in economic research, policy analysis, consulting, or financial services, with a proven track record of delivering impactful economic insights on India and global economies.
  
* Deep understanding of India's economic structure, including rural and urban consumption trends, production ecosystems, external trade dynamics, credit and lending markets, and financial sector regulations.
  
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex economic concepts into clear, concise, and compelling narratives for diverse audiences, including media engagements.
  
* Strong client\-facing capabilities with experience in presenting economic insights to senior stakeholders, policymakers, and industry leaders.

title: Buying/Procurement Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 The Buying/Procurement Specialist is responsible for ensuring the timely availability of materials at factories, service sites, and suppliers. The role serves as the primary point of contact for order execution and is accountable for supplier performance, material availability, fulfilment KPIs, and cross\-functional coordination to support uninterrupted production.
   

  

**Supplier Management**
* Ensure timely PO placement and material delivery as per contractual commitments.
* Manage procurement based on MRP requirements and need dates.
* Monitor supplier OTD (On\-Time Delivery) and quality performance.
* Lead discussions related to material shortages and supply crises.
* Obtain and review supplier progress reports.
* Identify supplier\-caused delays and drive recovery/back\-charge actions where applicable.
* Execute supplier improvement plans and corrective actions.
* Ensure suppliers are paid on time.
* Deliver fulfilment KPIs consistently.


**Cross functional coordination**
* Manage the complete order fulfilment cycle.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Quality, Logistics, Sourcing, and Supplier Quality teams.
* Facilitate inspections, NCR closures, and transportation planning.
* Support new product development and supplier onboarding activities.
* Collaborate with Wabtec network factories and offshore suppliers.
* Participate in daily material and production review meetings.


**Reporting \& material visibility**
* Provide end\-to\-end material visibility and tracking.
* Monitor material movement between suppliers and factories until GRN.
* Drive best practices in MRP/MTA planning and fulfilment processes.
* Lead or participate in supplier performance rating and improvement programs.
* Maintain accurate reporting and analytics for management reviews.


**Required Skills**
**Technical \& Functional Skills**
* Procurement and supplier management.
* MRP and production planning understanding.
* ERP knowledge (Oracle preferred).
* Advanced Excel and MS Office skills.
* Data analysis and reporting capabilities.
* Understanding of engineering drawings and manufacturing processes.
* Commercial acumen and contract awareness.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Problem\-solving and proactive mindset.
* Conflict resolution abilities.
* Strong collaboration and networking skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple suppliers/projects simultaneously.


**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**
* Supplier OTD performance.
* Material availability versus production requirements.
* Line stoppage prevention.
* Inventory and material visibility accuracy.
* Supplier issue resolution turnaround time.
* Fulfilment KPI achievement.
* Supplier payment compliance.


**Organizational Reporting**
 Hierarchical reporting to Fulfillment Leader
   

  

**Education \& Working Experience**
 B.E./B.Tech from any reputed institute.
   

  

 Minimum 5\+ years of experience.
   

  

**Language Skills**
* Proficient in English language


**Base Location**
* Marhowrah (Saran).


**Travel**
* Need based to All India based suppliers.


**Additional Information**
**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**
 At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other.
   

  

 If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

title: Front Office Executive
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Welcome to Amaha, where we’re redefining mental health care! Founded in 2016 by the visionary Dr. Amit Malik and social entrepreneur Neha Kirpal, Amaha (formerly InnerHour) is on a mission to create a supportive mental health ecosystem. We provide comprehensive treatment and care plans for a variety of mental health conditions, including anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, ADHD, OCD, schizophrenia, and addictions.
 



 With a dedicated team of over 150 experts, we’ve delivered more than 100,000 therapy sessions in 15\+ languages across 600\+ Indian cities. Our award\-winning Amaha app offers 600\+ self\-care tools and resources, impacting the lives of over 5 million people globally. We also support workplaces and colleges with customized emotional well\-being programs, reaching over 700,000 individuals.
 



 In 2022, we expanded our reach by acquiring the Child and Adolescent Mental Health Institute, Children First, allowing us to provide holistic care for families and communities. Join us as we continue to grow and innovate in the mental health space!
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Patient Interaction:** 



* Greeting and welcoming patients and visitors, creating a positive first impression.
* Answering phone calls, taking messages, and directing calls to the appropriate personnel or departments.
* Providing information to patients and visitors about hospital services, procedures, and policies.
* Assisting patients with registration, appointment scheduling, and payment processing.



**Administrative Tasks:** 



* Maintaining and updating patient records, both physical and electronic.
* Handling billing, insurance verification, and payment collection.
* Managing correspondence, including mail and emails.
* Coordinating with other departments to ensure smooth patient flow and efficient operations.
* Maintaining the cleanliness and organisation of the front office and reception area.



**General Support:** 



* Monitoring and managing office supplies and equipment.
* Assisting with special projects or tasks as assigned by the administration.
* Ensuring the confidentiality of patient information and adhering to HIPAA regulations.



  





**Qualifications and Skills Required:** 




 ● A bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
 



 ● Previous experience in a customer\-facing role, particularly in a healthcare setting, is often beneficial.
 



 ● 2\+ years in the field, with prior experience in a hospital or in hospitality.
 



 ● High\-quality organizational and administrative skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
 



 ● Proven expertise in managing patient services and enhancing patient satisfaction.
 



 ● Ability to work in flexible hours.
 



 ● Ability to handle multiple tasks effectively and priorities duties.
 



 ● Capable of performing physical tasks required in patient care and movement.
 



 ● Looking for candidates from Bangalore who can communicate in English, Hindi and Kannada.

title: REF111568S- Assistant Manager - Accounts Receivable
description:
**Company Description**
 WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI\-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI\-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human\-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Assistant Manager \- AR Operations supervises Accounts Receivable activities supporting container terminal operations within a ports, maritime, shipping, and logistics finance environment. The role oversees terminal billing, collections, AR aging, cash application, revenue capture, reconciliations, and month\-end close activities while ensuring SLA adherence, financial controls, compliance, and stakeholder satisfaction.
   

  

 The incumbent is responsible for understanding how operational transactions captured in Navis N4 translate into billing, revenue recognition, cash application, accounting entries, and financial reporting within OASYS
   

  

**Role Focus Areas**
* Queue leadership and workload management
* Collections governance and AR control
* Billing oversight and dispute resolution
* Cash Application and revenue capture governance
* Month\-end close and reconciliation oversight
* Team coaching and stakeholder management
* Compliance and control adherence


**Key Responsibilities**
**Terminal Billing Governance**
* Own billing governance for customer invoicing activities.
* Validate Navis N4 billing activity and ensure revenue capture accuracy and completeness.
* Manage billing disputes, adjustments, and customer escalations.
* Review and approve customer billing adjustments and credit memos.
* Ensure billing accuracy and revenue integrity across assigned terminals.
* Partner with Customer Service, Operations, Planning, and Port Operations stakeholders to ensure accurate billing and revenue capture.


**Accounts Receivable \& Collections**
* Manage AR aging performance and collections governance.
* Monitor customer payment status and collection effectiveness.
* Drive timely follow\-up and resolution of overdue receivables.
* Review collection escalations and customer disputes.
* Ensure adherence to AR policies, procedures, and collection strategies


**Cash application \& PayCargo**
* Oversee cash application activities and receipt matching.
* Ensure accurate application of customer payments.
* Review PayCargo settlement processing and exception handling.
* Drive timely resolution of unapplied and misapplied cash


**General Ledger \& Reconciliations**
* Review journal entries and support documentation.
* Oversee balance sheet and subledger reconciliations.
* Ensure timely resolution of reconciling items and control exceptions.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and financial support schedules


**Month\-End Close \& Reporting**
* Govern\-the\-month end close activities, including accruals and allocations.
* Review AR reserve calculations and account analyses.
* Ensure close calendar adherence and reporting accuracy.
* Review recurring and ad hoc financial reports.
* Maintain documentation readiness for audits and management review


**Process \& Compliance**
* Ensure SOP, internal control, and security compliance.
* Drive process improvements and finance cross\-training.
* Escalate risks and discrepancies with complete documentation.


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Manage daily work allocation, aging, quality sampling, and escalations.
* Review billing, AR, cash application, GL, and reconciliation outputs.
* Coach team members and ensure adherence to controls and policies.
* Partner with Terminal Operations, Customer Service, Planning teams, and Port Operations stakeholders.
* Manage escalations and stakeholder communications.
* Drive process improvements, cross\-training, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related discipline.
* 5\+ years of Accounts Receivable, Collections, Billing, or Finance Operations experience.
* Experience leading teams, managing service delivery, and driving operational performance.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Container terminal billing experience including lift, restow, flip, stevedoring, and M\&R charges.
* Knowledge of Navis N4 or terminal operating systems.
* Experience in maritime, ports, freight, or logistics finance.
* Exposure to PayCargo and legacy accounting systems.


**Systems \& Tools**
* OASYS or comparable ERP/accounting systems
* Navis N4 operational data validation
* PayCargo or similar payment platforms
* Excel, MS Office, and documentation repositories


**Success Measures / KPIs**
* 
+ Billing Governance Effectiveness
+ Billing Accuracy
+ Revenue Capture Completeness
+ Billing Dispute Resolution
+ Credit Memo Turnaround Time
+ AR Aging Control
+ Collection Effectiveness
+ Cash Application Accuracy
+ Unapplied Cash Resolution
+ Reconciliation Quality
+ Month\-End Close Adherence
+ Documentation Readiness
+ SLA \& Quality Compliance

Candidates should understand how Navis N4 operational activity translates into billing, customer receivables, revenue recognition, cash application and accounting transactions within OASYS.

title: AMEA S4 MTI Warehousing Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**
**SAP S/4 Hana and o9 Planning Transformation is a multi\-year, global program to transform and optimize business capabilities in service of our Vision 2030\.**
 As we continue to develop the AMEA MSC S4 team we are delighted to announce new MTI\-Manufacturing role opportunities within the AMEA S4 MSC Regional Delivery Team. This team will be critical to drive the digital change within the SAP S4H programme in what will be a multi\-year journey delivering a major investment in MDLZ that will simplify, transform and optimise our business capabilities.
   

  

 This role is responsible for driving all plants in AMEA through the design validation, harmonization, optimization and implementation of Warehousing and Inventory Management process as part of the S4 HANA transformation programme.
   

  

 This role will work closely with SMEs for other MTI processes and key MSC stakeholders to ensure AMEA alignment with global/ regional S4H design. The role will also include identifying harmonization / simplification opportunities in processes and ways of working across AMEA.
   

  

 This role will lead the Key user Community of practice for Warehousing \& Inventory Management (WMS \& IM) processes to prepare for S4 transformation and drive continuous improvement and harmonisation, bringing together process experts form AMEA plants.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 You will assess all current Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to Warehousing (CWM/DWM) and IM, to check compatibility and workability within the future S4H design (EWM) and ensure they are aligned with business requirements. Example subprocesses in scope would include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Receive Materials
* Supply materials to Production
* Manage Internal Movements
* Manage Physical Inventory
* Write\-off Obsolete Materials
* Goods Receipt from Production
* Outbound Process
* Manage Master Data


**Design Validation** 
 : Act as the regional subject matter expert on all WMS \& IM processes. Work and coordinate with process experts from plants, region and global to help validate the S4 HANA global design. Defines best practice in alignment with Global team.
   

  

**Gap Analysis \& Harmonization** 
 : Identify process gaps, evaluate harmonization opportunities, scoping of flows, and co\-ordinate feedback to the regional team. Provide information and explanations to help contextualise any deviations, develop business cases for process standardisation across AMEA and escalate critical issues that may require specific AMEA support to solve.
   

  

**Decision Documentation** 
 : provide detailed input and explanations for key decision documents (KDDs) for required AMEA process adaptations, while recognising alignment with the overall global S4 strategy.
   

  

**Testing \& Validation:** 
 Work with key users to define and implement testing and validation approaches as applicable. Support the definition of the testing strategy, scope, and preparation of test cases. Depending on the project phase, the SME role will perform testing and also support key users during testing and perform defect management activities.
   

  

**Change Management \& Adoption** 
 : Support change management activities to ensure smooth adoption of any process changes across plants, support training, upskilling, and capability development using clear and timely communication. Develop and keep up to date training documentation and re\-training of key users. Lead the Key User community activities.
   

  

**BCP (business continuity plan):** 
 Develop and maintain BCP guidelines to mitigate risks during implementation of S4 and beyond. Support plants to localise the BCP to specific plant needs. Share and align details with regional S4 BCP planning team.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management** 
 : Act as the bridge between different teams affected by the process; including Supply hub, other MTI sub processes, LogOps, Procurement, Master data, Internal Controls, Finance and MDS.
   

  

**Master data:** 
 Define Master data requirements for data objects owned by the process, supporting the validation activities.
   

  

**Cutover:** 
 Work closely with the central and local teams providing functional support to build cutover plan. Supports preparation and execution of cutover activities during trials and golive cutover, as set by the regional S4 team.
   

  

**Hypercare:** 
 Supports Key users during hypercare phase post golive. Gives functional supports to Accenture for defect resolution.
   

  

**Housekeeping:** 
 Defines housekeeping best practice and provides guidance to KU.
   

  

**SAP job roles:** 
 Supports SAP job roles activities by approving SAP job roles access to end users and cooperating with Internal Controls to identify risks and sensitive access rights.
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career combined with the following experience and knowledge:
   

  

* Hands on experience on SAP WMS Systems (CWM/EWM/DWM) and Inventory Management in a manufacturing plant, understanding of Business process including interaction with other business processes and end to end.
* SAP ECC technical operational background with clear understanding of SAP transactions and processes with the ability to execute SAP transactions within a test environment
* Understanding of data structure and principles involved in these processes.
* Background in business processes, gap analysis, and harmonization initiatives.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with plant stakeholders and other SMEs. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders across business and technical functions.
* Experience in supporting change and delivering training and business adoption initiatives.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business process needs into practical systemic solutions.
* Project and result\-oriented with a strong focus on delivering high\-quality outcomes.
* Proactive and adaptable, with the ability to deal with multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, and dynamic environment.
* Flexible, can\-do attitude, continuous improvement mindset.


**More About This Role**
**Education / Certifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree level qualifications or equivalent workplace experience required.


**Job specific requirements:**
* 4\-8 years of operational and business experience working and using SAP / multi systems environment.
* Hands\-on experience of working in a warehouse with WMS systems \& operations with strong knowledge of the requirements, processes, and principles.


**Experience In Project Management**
 Travel requirements: Very limited travel is expected for ad hoc regional team meetings or project phase, but majority of work will be through business communication platforms (MS Team, SharePoint etc).
   

  

 No Relocation support available
   

  

**Business Unit Summary**
 At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high\-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.

 You will work closely with global engineering teams across the UK, US, and APAC.
   

  

****Core Responsibilities****
 Operate, maintain, and continuously improve FNZ’s production security platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on platform operation with engineering improvements that enhance platform capability and reduce operational overhead.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include:**
* Configuring, operating, and optimising enterprise security platforms
* Supporting platform upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management
* Monitoring platform health, reliability, and performance
* Troubleshooting operational issues across security platforms
* Ensuring platforms operate in line with FNZ’s global security and operational standards
* Assisting with automation of platform configuration and operational workflows
* Supporting integrations between security platforms and internal systems
* Writing scripts or tooling to improve operational efficiency
* Supporting infrastructure automation or configuration improvements
* Helping improve telemetry pipelines and data flows between security platforms


 Engineers are expected to approach platform operations with an engineering mindset
 **,** 
 identifying opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency over time
   

  

 Incident Engineering Support
   

  

 Provide engineering support during security incidents where platform expertise is required.
   

  

**This Includes:**
* Supporting incident response teams with platform troubleshooting
* Assisting with root\-cause analysis
* Helping implement fixes and improvements following incidents


 The focus is platform engineering support, not incident monitoring or SOC investigation.
   

  

 Platform Reliability \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Work with the wider engineering team to improve the maturity and reliability of FNZ’s security platform environment.
   

  

**This Includes:**
* Identifying recurring operational issues
* Contributing to automation initiatives
* Improving platform observability and operational metrics
* Supporting adoption of new security tools and platform capabilities


 Working Pattern
   

  

 The team provides global coverage across shifts aligned with international operations.
   

  

 Core hours will align with APAC and EMEA collaboration, with occasional out\-of\-hours work required during major incidents or platform maintenance windows.
   

  

****Required Experience****
 Candidates should demonstrate hands\-on experience operating enterprise security platforms.
   

  

**Typical Background Includes:**
* 3–6 years in cyber security engineering or platform engineering roles
* Hands\-on experience working with enterprise security platforms
* Experience troubleshooting operational issues across security controls
* Experience working within distributed global engineering teams


 Technical Experience
   

  

 Experience across several of the following security platform domains is expected:
   

  

* Endpoint security platforms (EDR / XDR) such as CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne
* Secure Web Gateway / Proxy platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, iBoss, Prisma Access
* Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and application\-layer protection platforms
* Security logging and SIEM platforms
* Email security platforms and secure email gateways
* Vulnerability management platforms
* Network security controls, including next\-generation firewalls


 Candidates should demonstrate experience operating, configuring, and supporting these platforms in production environments.
   

  

 Engineering \& Automation Experience
   

  

**Experience In The Following Areas Is Beneficial:**
* scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar)
* working with APIs for platform integrations
* infrastructure automation or configuration management
* operating security tooling in cloud environments


 Nice to Have
   

  

**Experience In The Following Areas Would Be Beneficial:**
* infrastructure\-as\-code or DevOps practices
* cloud security platform engineering
* integrating security tooling within CI/CD pipelines
* platform telemetry and observability tooling


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will:**
* support the reliable operation of FNZ’s security platforms
* contribute to engineering improvements and automation initiatives
* help maintain platform performance and stability
* collaborate effectively with global engineering teams
* grow technical expertise across FNZ’s security platform ecosystem


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 Security platforms form a critical part of FNZ’s global technology infrastructure.
   

  

**The Cyber Platform Engineering Team Ensures These Platforms Remain:**
* reliable
* scalable
* well\-engineered
* continuously improving


 This role contributes directly to maintaining the security and resilience of FNZ’s global environment.
   

  

***About FNZ***
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end\-to\-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2\.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
   

  

 Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

description:

 Network \& Security OEMs, ISPs/Telecoms, System Integrators, Cloud Providers, VoIP Vendors, Global Suppliers
 



  





**Education:** 




 BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree
 



  





**Experience:** 




 4\+Yrs of experience in managing and installation of Network Devices, Firewalls

**Functional\-**

* Strong customer service orientation

title: Enterprise App Admin II
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
   

  

 Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
   

  

**About Five9**
 Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 brings the power of AI and cloud innovation to customer experience software worldwide.
   

  

 Living our values drives our team\-first culture, helping us innovate, grow, and thrive together.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an HR Applications Administrator to join our Business Technology / Enterprise Applications team, responsible for administering, configuring, and supporting the applications behind Five9’s HR, Payroll, and Talent programs, primarily UKG (formerly UltiPro), with additional support for Deel, Greenhouse, and various other HR applications. This role partners closely with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors to keep our HR systems secure, reliable, and effective.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has hands\-on UKG administration experience, along with a UKG Pro certification, strongly preferred. Candidates with substantial Workday administration experience and a Workday certification may also be a strong fit. This person communicates clearly, partners well across HR, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and vendor teams, and manages day\-to\-day administration independently.
   

  

 The position is a hybrid role combining in\-office and work\-from\-home days, based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time when needed.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Administer and configure Five9’s HR applications on a day\-to\-day basis, with primary focus on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro), including system settings, business rules, and module configuration
* Maintain system security roles, permissions, and access controls across HR applications to ensure appropriate data protection and compliance with company policy
* Build, test, and maintain business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications within UKG Pro and related HR systems
* Support and maintain integrations between UKG Pro, Deel, Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, Replicon, and other business applications, partnering with Business Technology teams as needed
* Perform system testing, including validation of configuration changes, patches, and vendor releases prior to production deployment
* Coordinate periodic vendor releases and platform updates, assessing impact to existing configuration and coordinating regression testing with stakeholders
* Monitor data quality across HR systems, and identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data integrity issues
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support HR, Payroll, and business stakeholder reporting needs
* Maintain clear, current documentation of system configurations, processes, and support procedures
* Provide day\-to\-day user support and troubleshooting for HR application end users, resolving issues in a timely manner
* Manage vendor relationships for supported HR applications, including support tickets, escalations, and roadmap discussions
* Support the AI Center of Excellence by identifying and helping implement opportunities to leverage AI to automate hire\-to\-retire and payroll\-related processes
* Partner with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, and InfoSec teams to gather requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Required Qualifications**
* A minimum of 5 years of experience administering enterprise Human Resources applications, with hands\-on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro) experience as the primary qualification
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience managing security roles, permissions, and access controls within an HRIS platform
* Experience building and maintaining business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications
* Experience supporting integrations between HR systems and other enterprise applications
* Experience with system testing, including validating configuration changes and vendor releases prior to production deployment
* Experience monitoring and maintaining data quality and data integrity across HR systems
* Experience building reports and dashboards to support HR and business reporting needs
* Strong documentation skills, with the ability to maintain clear and current process and configuration documentation
* Experience providing end\-user support and troubleshooting for HR applications
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors
* Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and coordination on releases


**Preferred Qualifications**
* UKG Pro certification (strongly preferred)
* Workday certification, for candidates whose primary HRIS administration experience is with Workday
* Deel certification preferred
* Experience with Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, or Replicon desired
* Experience administering another major Human Resources Information System, supported by relevant qualifications or certifications


**Why You’ll Love This Role**
* You will play a key role in supporting and evolving the technology that powers Five9’s HR, Payroll, and Talent programs
* You will work hands\-on with UKG Pro and gain exposure to a broader ecosystem of leading HR platforms
* You will use cutting\-edge technologies, including AI, to help create great employee experiences
* You will build strong partnerships across Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and vendor teams
* If you enjoy solving practical problems, safeguarding data quality, and delivering excellent support to HR technology users, this role offers strong opportunities to grow your HRIS expertise


 Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.
   

  

 Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.

title: Data Center Operations Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day\-to\-day work will include:
   

  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift\-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.


**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
